name: Star Sea · 689
title: Star Sea · 689
description: In 689, freighters dock at Jubilee Hub around the clock. The exchange prices shipping lanes while crews in the outer ring patch pressure leaks. The fleet watches the frontier and merchants watch freight rates. Both rely on outposts marked by a single number on the chart.

xinghai-l01.name: Juberly Outer Ring Decompression Corridor No. 47
xinghai-l01.brief_description: Juberly Outer Ring Decompression Corridor No. 47.
xinghai-l01.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A low-level maintenance corridor at the outermost edge of the hub, relying on centrifugal force to maintain microgravity. Steel plates are crudely welded together; exposed high-pressure conduits constantly vent condensing mists carrying the pungent stench of ozone and freon, while overhead holographic billboards flicker with shoddy, pale patches of light.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: A gathering haven for unlicensed black-market laborers, forged-credential peddlers, and runaway aborigines from low-tier civilizations. Underclass day laborers survive by clearing out waste-heat exhaust valves for small cargo freighters in exchange for meager Enar tokens.
- **Access Conditions**: No open checkpoint exists, but autonomous hub patrol float-orbs conduct identity scans every twenty minutes. Anyone without valid transit authorization faces forcible deportation or being purged into the vacuum of space.
- **Transit Links**: Climb up the service shaft ladder to reach the back alley of Old Anchor Bar (L02); take the negative-pressure lift capsule to the Mercenary Guild Administrative Hall (L04).

## Contacts and everyday life

This corridor belongs to Juberly’s outer ring, not one room spanning Garton. Duty workers can point toward Old Anchor’s alley, the commission hall and freight tracks; the inner dock keeps separate engineering access. Scrap boards and pipes are visible without all being ownerless.

Workers seek temporary repairs, meal paste and pressure-safe rest. Sylva’s knowledge of bins and Monto’s billing records are different sources. Arrears, inspection and purging matter when they actually concern the person present. Sunil auxiliaries and Floating Dragon runners do not inherit someone else’s bill upon arrival. Leaving a dangerous section, seeking work or asking help does not automatically accept a clearance job.

xinghai-l02.name: Old Anchor Machine Bar and Secondhand Ship Material Bazaar
xinghai-l02.brief_description: Old Anchor Machine Bar and Secondhand Ship Material Bazaar.
xinghai-l02.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A sunken tavern retrofitted from the main ballast hold of a decommissioned heavy barge. The counter is reinforced with lead shielding ripped from scrapped reactors. The air is thick with a rancid stench of machine oil, synthetic vodka, and alien sweat glands; the rear hall is haphazardly packed with stripped salvage parts from various starship models.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Retired mercenaries, fencing brokers, and interstellar smugglers trading illicit cargo. The retired Sunil veteran Melos stays perpetually plastered on a tattered sofa in the corner.
- **Access Conditions**: Guarded at the door by two heavily armored bouncers carrying high-voltage electromagnetic shotguns; long-barreled kinetic firearms must have physical safety plugs inserted before entry.
- **Transit Links**: The front entrance opens into Decompression Corridor (L01); a secret back door leads straight into the Abandoned Waste Well (L05).

## Contacts and everyday life

The bar and used-parts stalls share an outer-ring trade district but have different owners and negotiators. Old Anchor can restrain violence inside, not guarantee immunity after departure. A dealer may sell an old board without guaranteeing it has never been altered.

Melos’s sofa is a habitual seat, not a summonable mercenary slot. Buying food, checking prices and asking about dock vacancies do not require gambling. A drainage passage’s destination and its safety need separate checks; hearing about a shortcut grants no engineering access. Rumours can retain an identifiable speaker without spreading private medical or job details to the whole room.

xinghai-l03.name: Hub No. 3 Vacuum Refit Drydock
xinghai-l03.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A semi-enclosed massive industrial shipyard where magnetic containment fields separate internal air pressure from the outer vacuum. Four hundred-meter heavy hydraulic gantry trusses glide along tracks, cascading welding sparks like a rainstorm across mottled warship hulls.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: The berthing ground where the Black Star Mercenary Group carried out its early starship overhauls, serving as a bustling worksite for heavy armor plate fitters and reactor technicians.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires presentation of a Special-Grade Engineering Maintenance Permit or verbal clearance from an on-duty core member of the Black Star Mercenary Group.
- **Transit Links**: Internal rail tram reaches the Administrative Hall (L04) in three minutes; heavy freight slipways link directly to the Outer Ring Industrial Zone (L01).

The propulsion bench takes frigates by the hour. Engineers experienced in reactor overdrive can book repairs at fifty credits and one unit of marine alloy per hour, covering hullwork, wiring and fuel. Permanent sleeve wear stays on the service sheet; nobody here stamps a damaged reactor as new.

## Contacts and everyday life

Within Juberly, the dock separates its waiting and receiving desk, repair bays and hazardous power sections. Han Xiao’s team working here does not admit every tram passenger into vacuum operations. Visitors first explain their contact and abilities to the duty worker, then discuss trial work or repairs.

The hall tram and outer-ring freight line are local links, not interstellar passage. Dealer quotes, measured wear and client requests need separate checking. Repairs do not erase permanent wear. Full bays leave options to wait, source material or ask another workshop; an offer to help transfers no ship or machinery into player ownership.

xinghai-l04.name: Interstellar Mercenary Guild Juberly Office
xinghai-l04.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A grand domed hall spanning over twenty thousand square meters. Floating at the center is a three-story-tall holographic bulletin pillar, scrolling and refreshing bounties in flashing red and blue. Thousands of alien beings queue before hundreds of alloy service counters, accompanied by the hollow, cold chime of automated ticketing systems.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Mercenary credential archiving, interstellar bounty verification and payout, death-duel contract notarization, and black-market intelligence arbitration.
- **Access Conditions**: Must pass full-spectrum weapon and biohazard security gates; a first-time filing fee of 100 Enars must be paid to the Guild.
- **Transit Links**: The primary transit artery of the hub, outfitted with high-speed pneumatic shuttles providing direct transit to all major starship mooring spires.

xinghai-l05.name: Blind End of Abandoned Waste Decompression Well No. 47
xinghai-l05.brief_description: Blind End of Abandoned Waste Decompression Well No. 47.
xinghai-l05.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A shattered section of abandoned conduit completely sealed off after an ancient reactor meltdown. Gravity is turbulent, and walls are overgrown with luminescent, radiation-resistant mutant moss. Wrecked probes that drifted in from deep space can occasionally be salvaged from piles of industrial slag.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: The final refuge for interstellar stowaways and a secret dead drop for smuggled weaponry; DarkStar deathsworn occasionally swap neurotoxin components here.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires wearing a Tier 3 heat-resistant gas mask and manually prying open the rusted-shut decompression pressure valve.
- **Transit Links**: Connects to the peripheral gaps of L01 and the back alley of L02; no regular public transit exists.

xinghai-l06.name: Iron Fortress First Defensive Line
xinghai-l06.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A circular steel bastion erected along black basalt mountain ranges by the Sunil race using armored steel plates. The outer walls are caked in dried, blackened blood of mutant beasts, while heavy twin-linked electromagnetic close-in weapon systems remain permanently aimed at the howling wasteland.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Headquarters for Sunil regular frontline defense forces and an exoskeleton power-armor emergency repair workshop. The race's prime combat forces hold the line here with flesh and blood against periodic catastrophic beast waves.
- **Access Conditions**: Strictly military-controlled zone; outsiders must present a Sunil military mercenary agreement or a Mercenary Guild frontline volunteer deployment voucher.
- **Transit Links**: Heavy six-axle armored troop trains run directly to the Underground Refugee Mother City (L08) to the rear; dropship rail tracks lead to the Outer Containment Dead Line (L07).

## Contacts and everyday life

Ironcast Fortress stands on Sunil’s front. Outside support first reports to reception and logistics; positions, repair benches and medical stations have separate duty personnel. An auxiliary familiar with the barracks does not own the armoury or command troops. Reilmonte’s assignments and Lina’s treatment needs may compete; clarify what help is actually possible.

The rear city has troop transport and lifts; the outer dead line presents different dangers. Leaving a sector is not instant travel to Juberly. Carrying stretchers, repairs and returning tags are useful, and someone unfit may ask to withdraw. An alarm needs an outpost report, witness or actual message. Every visit need not spawn a fresh beast wave, nor does relocation heal patients.

xinghai-l07.name: Ashen Basin Outer Containment Dead Line
xinghai-l07.brief_description: Ashen Basin Outer Containment Dead Line.
xinghai-l07.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A scorched expanse repeatedly leveled by orbital bombardment. The terrain is riddled with acid craters dozens of meters deep, the air is thick with lethal mutagenic spores, and the ground is strewn with severed exoskeleton limbs and bleached beast skeletons.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: A high-risk no-man's-land reserved for tactical readiness, frequented only by reclamation squads recovering dog tags of fallen soldiers and elite mercenaries hunting mutant crystal cores.
- **Access Conditions**: Mandatory wearing of fully sealed heavy CBRN hazard suits; solitary excursions without heavy weaponry are strictly forbidden.
- **Transit Links**: Accessible from L06 via all-terrain tracked assault vehicles; a rough two-hour journey each way.

xinghai-l08.name: Sunil Underground Refugee Mother City
xinghai-l08.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A subterranean metallic honeycomb metropolis carved out of deep granite mountains. Cascading blast nets hang from cavernous ceilings beneath dim yellow lights. Millions of civilians and children wait here for meager rations of genetic inhibitor suppressants hauled back from the front line.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: The Sunil's sole remaining rear-area heavy manufacturing plant, water purification facility, and seat of the Council of Elders, submerged in a tragic atmosphere of desperate self-preservation.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires passing through triple-stage intensive radiation decontamination and blood biochemical screening; non-Sunil individuals must wear self-destruct tracking wristbands.
- **Transit Links**: Heavy-duty vertical cargo lifts connect to the Fortress (L06); subterranean heavy-fuel pipe galleries lead to the Shelter (L09).

xinghai-l09.name: Genetic Decay Terminal Shelter
xinghai-l09.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A chilling corridor lined with thousands of eerie green cryo-stasis life-support capsules. The pungent smell of chemical preservatives cannot mask the stench of necrotizing tissue, where veteran warriors tortured by genetic collapse await brain death.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Frontline combat medics, silently weeping widows, and researchers conducting trial injections of trace gene stabilizers.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires a family visitation pass issued by the Sunil Medical Emergency Committee or a Special-Grade Medical Expert Clearance.
- **Transit Links**: Located within the deepest southwestern cavern of L08, accessible on foot.

xinghai-l10.name: Rift Covert Observation Outpost
xinghai-l10.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A spherical camouflaged bunker deeply embedded into the sheer cliff walls of the mutant beast breeding rift. The outer shell is coated with infrared-absorbing paint, monitoring horde concentrations across the canyon floor relying purely on a passive sonar array.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: A forward rotating post for deathsworn sentries, tasked with transmitting full-band Red-Alert codes to the fortress thirty minutes prior to an erupting beast wave.
- **Access Conditions**: No formal checkpoint, but the surrounding twenty kilometers of cliffs crawl with stealthy cliff-climbing mutant beasts.
- **Transit Links**: Connected to the outer watchtower of L06 solely via a manual pulley cable suspended across a thousand-meter abyss.

xinghai-l11.name: Holy Gold Skyport Welcome Space Station
xinghai-l11.brief_description: Holy Gold Skyport Welcome Space Station.
xinghai-l11.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A ring-shaped artificial skyport situated in the geostationary orbit of the capital homeworld, built entirely of pure white seismic-resistant nano-alloys and gilded photovoltaic panels. Colossal holographic light projections depict the glorious heritage of the pureblood nobility alongside ethereal orchestral melodies.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: A gathering hub for cross-cluster diplomatic envoys, megacorporation compradors, and royal commissioners. Official Godora censors carry out haughty screenings of all incoming vessels here.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires presenting a Godora Tier 3 or higher civilization visa or a Special Guarantee Code; aborigines from secondary civilizations must submit to stripped decontamination inside quarantine pods.
- **Transit Links**: An orbital space elevator descends straight down to the surface (L12); high-speed jump rings provide transit throughout the star system.

xinghai-l12.name: Sunflower Parliament Avenue
xinghai-l12.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: The political nucleus of the surface capital. Lined with hundreds of meters of golden flagstone paving, parliamentary halls and royal temples flank both sides as pureblood officials sweep past in anti-gravity crystal limousines.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: The venue for sector budget bills, arms procurement quota battles, and the drafting of disenfranchisement acts directed at lower-class half-bloods.
- **Access Conditions**: Strictly off-limits to half-bloods and enslaved laborers from contaminated civilizations; armed cybernetic peacekeepers patrol equipped with lethal-grade concussive spears.
- **Transit Links**: High-speed maglev subways connect to L13 and L14.

xinghai-l13.name: Sunken Half-Blood Slums 'Rust Belt'
xinghai-l13.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: An abyssal city smothered beneath the colossal industrial canopy of the homeworld, utterly devoid of sunlight year-round. Acid rain drips from ruptured drainage conduits, as tens of millions of disenfranchised half-blood outcasts eke out an existence.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Illicit underground cybernetics workshops, covert outposts for half-blood insurgencies, and black-market labor brokers. The hatred fueling DarkStar takes root and festers here.
- **Access Conditions**: Security forces maintain fortified checkpoints checking work permits; anyone carrying printed materials deemed subversive to pureblood supremacy is executed on sight.
- **Transit Links**: Battered ore slag haulers lead to the surface waste dumps; drainage networks connect directly to the Secret Nest (L15).

xinghai-l14.name: Royal Academy of Life Sciences Genetics Institute
xinghai-l14.brief_description: Royal Academy of Life Sciences Genetics Institute.
xinghai-l14.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A transparent sphere floating inside an anti-gravity containment field, carrying out rigorous research into pureblood genetic purification and Esper seed awakening.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Elite life scientists and royal court physicians, displaying pathological revulsion and disdain toward hybrid genes.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires an order hand-signed by the Chief Scholar or an apex military technology transfer manifest.
- **Transit Links**: A dedicated anti-gravity light-lift goes directly to the Welcome Spire (L11).

xinghai-l15.name: DarkStar Surface Infiltration Secret Nest
xinghai-l15.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: An underground bunker tucked deep within an abandoned drainage pump station in the Rust Belt. Smeared across the walls in blood is the Godora solar crest pierced by a blade; tables are loaded with high-yield explosives and forged identity coders.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: DarkStar deathsworn and pureblood assassination squads, waiting here for the mothership to issue the crimson decree for an all-out strike on Godora's administrative core.
- **Access Conditions**: Entrants must know passcodes rotated every three days and submit to hybrid bloodline purity tests via resonance scanners.
- **Transit Links**: A web of abandoned underground smuggling conduits extends to various critical defense nodes across the homeworld.

xinghai-l16.name: Floating Island Skyport Suspended Flight Deck
xinghai-l16.brief_description: Floating Island Skyport Suspended Flight Deck.
xinghai-l16.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A free floating island suspended in deep space, forged through the union of a colossal natural asteroid and anti-gravity dampeners. Thousands of suspended docking ramps jut from its perimeter, where fierce drafts buffet tattered banners.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Fugitives on the run from across the universe, wandering pugilists, and pilgrims coming to pay homage to Ames, the Dragon Sovereign. Floating Dragon guards collect standard administrative fees on-site.
- **Access Conditions**: Floating Dragon never inquires about a traveler's homeworld, bounties, or prior crimes, provided they do not commit murder in the open streets.
- **Transit Links**: Magnetic aerial walkways link to L17 and L18.

## Contacts and everyday life

The port is Floating Dragon’s first contact layer. Berthing, cargo inspection and passenger entry are separate services. Walkways reach the cliff market and cave bars; stepping onto the deck grants neither palace entry nor engine-core access.

Port staff know current berths, fees and public arrangements. Captains know their own voyages. Neither necessarily knows Jenny’s next diplomatic meeting. Disputes can start with receipts and the responsible person, a duty review or another lawful berth. A neutral port still has congestion, damage and misunderstandings; paying fees does not insure every deal. Departure needs an actual vessel and itinerary, not a walk from the market to another system.

xinghai-l17.name: Cliffside Rock Wall Black Market Corridor
xinghai-l17.brief_description: Cliffside Rock Wall Black Market Corridor.
xinghai-l17.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A spiraling terrace bazaar carved along the sheer cliffs of the asteroid. Alien hawkers hang sheets and dust screens, laying out contraband weaponry, ancient relics, and slave shock collars scavenged from various star sectors.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Bulk illicit contraband trade, wholesale high-energy raw crystals, and nameless assassin contracts.
- **Access Conditions**: Freely open to all; however, anyone who engages in violence and damages stalls will have their limbs broken by Floating Dragon guards and be hurled into deep space.
- **Transit Links**: Climb stone steps carved into the rock face directly up to the Governance Hall Plaza (L19), or descend into the lower-level power caverns.

## Contacts and everyday life

The cliff arcade is a commercial district with separate owners and thresholds at stalls, storage counters and the steps toward government offices. A runner knows passages actually travelled, not an island without doors. Reaching lower engine caves does not admit anyone to the core.

Inspecting goods, carrying messages, buying supplies and arranging repairs require actual owners and agreed limits. A bloodied chip becomes a particular person’s problem only if it really reached their hands; it is not imposed on a passing clearance worker or auxiliary. Avoiding a pursuit, seeking guards, consulting a trusted trader or refusing dubious goods are possible. Ordinary commerce continues when the player declines a conspiracy.

xinghai-l18.name: Floating Dragon Lower Cavern Bar
xinghai-l18.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A massive tavern retrofitted from a natural cavern. Dim red and green neon strips are wrapped around rugged stalactites, the room reeking of harsh spirits amid the frenzied table-thumping of gamblers.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: The stomping ground where Black Star recruited his early mercenary cadre. Exiled pugilists and heavily augmented mechanic fanatics band together here to take on private jobs.
- **Access Conditions**: Walk-ins welcome; drunkards dying at the tables are casually stripped bare by barkeeps and dumped into the back alley.
- **Transit Links**: Connects to the Market (L17); hidden crawlways lead down to the Core Engine Room (L20).

xinghai-l19.name: Palace of the Dragon Main Council Hall
xinghai-l19.brief_description: Palace of the Dragon Main Council Hall.
xinghai-l19.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: An ancient hall over a hundred meters tall, carved from a single seamless piece of midnight obsidian. Hovering dead ahead is a void throne condensed entirely from raw forcefields. Ames, the Dragon Sovereign, perennially rests here; the gravitational pull of the entire floating island rises and falls with her breath.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Where the Dragon Sovereign grants audience to her inner circle and Chief Officer Jenny exercises an iron fist over major commercial litigation and diplomatic mediation island-wide.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires an audience summons hand-signed by Jenny; guards confiscate all charged weapons and spatial compression equipment.
- **Transit Links**: The absolute core of the floating island, directly accessible via a dedicated anti-gravity elevator.

xinghai-l20.name: Floating Island Engine Core and Shield Hub
xinghai-l20.brief_description: Floating Island Engine Core and Shield Hub.
xinghai-l20.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: The deafening base of planetary-scale heavy nuclear thrusters. Superconducting power cables as massive as mountain ridges bite deep into the bedrock, while heavy autonomous sentry golems patrol the catwalks.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Garrison base for the Floating Dragon Engineering Guard, keeping vigilant watch over saboteurs targeting the propulsion system.
- **Access Conditions**: Red-grade hyper-restricted area; non-core technicians stepping within three meters instantly trigger gravity suppression traps.
- **Transit Links**: Connects to the rear chambers of L19 exclusively through the primary engineering blast gate.

xinghai-l21.name: Silver-Green Main Shipping Lane Zephyr Jump Point
xinghai-l21.brief_description: Silver-Green Main Shipping Lane Zephyr Jump Point.
xinghai-l21.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: An expanse of void encircled by hundreds of massive gravitational anchoring buoys, where spatial curvature churns violently. Every few minutes, ten-thousand-meter ore freighters rupture wormholes out of hyperspace, trailing brilliant pale-blue plasma wakes.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Resupply depot for Colton Shipping Guild escort fleets, rendezvous point for armed merchant convoys, and stalking grounds for lurking interstellar pirate spotters.
- **Access Conditions**: Payment of stargate transit surcharges calculated based on ship displacement.
- **Transit Links**: Main shipping routes lead directly to the Garton Galaxy and the Purple Gold Star Cluster; sub-light flight paths connect to the Asteroid Belt (L22).

xinghai-l22.name: Rubble Belt Exile Resupply Outpost
xinghai-l22.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A deep-space black market hollowed out from a thirty-kilometer-wide iron-rich asteroid. Coated in radar-absorbent materials to pass as an exhausted mine pit, its interior houses full fueling depots and life-support aeroponic farms.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Fencing depot for interstellar corsairs, refurbished black-market parts workshop, and safehouse for those dodging pursuit from major galactic civilizations.
- **Access Conditions**: Must tap a specific static response code—three longs and two shorts—across broad-spectrum radio channels.
- **Transit Links**: Small shuttles reach the Mining Ruins (L23) in thirty minutes.

xinghai-l23.name: Abandoned Kaya Deep-Space Mining Platform
xinghai-l23.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A skeletal metallic frame hanging forlornly at the rim of a gas giant's planetary rings. Most gravity modules have breached and decompressed; coagulated black spheres of waste lubricants and shed hull plates drift under zero gravity.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: An unpoliced zero-gravity arena and live-fire test ground for black-market arms.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires personal EVA propulsion suits.
- **Transit Links**: Shares a narrow asteroid belt corridor with L22.

xinghai-l24.name: Chaida Soilless Agricultural Biosphere Ring
xinghai-l24.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A rotating ring-shaped megastructure spanning over a hundred kilometers in diameter. Its inner surface is a vast expanse of genetically modified nutrient wheat fields and high-density synthetic protein vats, churning out cheap military field rations for the entire star sector.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Agrarian technicians, grain-and-oil trading syndicates, and bottom-tier contract laborers.
- **Access Conditions**: Stringent biological spore quarantine; bringing external living specimens inside is strictly forbidden.
- **Transit Links**: Large freight berths link directly to the sector's main transit corridors.

xinghai-l25.name: The Gray Finch Modified Armed Freighter
xinghai-l25.brief_description: The Gray Finch Modified Armed Freighter.
xinghai-l25.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A secondhand freighter whose propulsion drives and main battery have undergone brutal aftermarket overhauls. A shattered blade pendant from a Sunil warrior hangs in the cockpit, while the depths of the cargo hold rumble with the diesel-like clatter of backup generators.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Independent Captain Keran and her battle-hardened crew, taking on high-risk smuggling and transport jobs.
- **Access Conditions**: Boarding requires Captain Keran's personal approval.
- **Transit Links**: Roams between the Garton Galaxy and surrounding unclaimed star systems.

xinghai-l26.name: Crimson Empire Expeditionary Vanguard Stargate Fortress
xinghai-l26.brief_description: Crimson Empire Expeditionary Vanguard Stargate Fortress.
xinghai-l26.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A deep-crimson steel mobile fortress over a hundred kilometers long, thrust into the heart of the sea of stars like a heavy greatsword. Thousands of Imperial heavy star dreadnoughts lie slumbering in their berths, exuding suffocating military dominance.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Imperial Heavy Guard forces, pugilist elite instructors, and military commissars. Rank and illustrious battle honors are the only currency recognized here.
- **Access Conditions**: Must hold deployment orders from the Imperial General Staff or a Beyond Grade A vassal summons.
- **Transit Links**: Special hyperspace corridors connect directly to the Imperial Homeworld in the Primeval Star River.

xinghai-l27.name: Radiant Federation Pantheon Star Cluster Peripheral Office
xinghai-l27.brief_description: Radiant Federation Pantheon Star Cluster Peripheral Office.
xinghai-l27.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: An opulent artificial planet engineered from countless precision gears and antimatter crystal spires. A colossal holographic projection of the "Pantheon Monument" pierces into the nebula, symbolizing ancient and unshakeable truths.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Directors of the universe's foremost megacorporations, Federation senators, and mercenary brokers, secretly orchestrating proxy wars across underdeveloped civilizations.
- **Access Conditions**: Verified account assets of no less than one million Enars.
- **Transit Links**: Features ultra-long-range quantum jump stargates linking directly to major star cluster hubs.

xinghai-l28.name: Void Temple Deep-Space Prayer Sanctuary
xinghai-l28.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A violet crystalline megastructure hovering on the brink of a void rift. Space is folded and warped here by invisible divine telekinesis, with higher-dimensional murmurs audible from the depths of the Void Dimension.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Fanatical high priests, void ascetics, and zealots attempting to cast off mortal flesh through dogmatic indoctrination.
- **Access Conditions**: Mental resilience must pass tests set by baptismal crystals; those with fragile psyches are instantly turned into gibbering husks.
- **Transit Links**: Must be escorted through the void vortex by specialized Phantom escorts.

xinghai-l29.name: Mechanized Empire
xinghai-l29.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A metallic planet utterly transformed by cybernetics and mechanization. The crust consists of heavy drive gears and fusion cores, while the sky is illuminated by sparks cascading from billions of assembly lines, entirely devoid of organic life.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Mechanist zealots and synthetic constructs stripped entirely of flesh, turning out apocalyptic autonomous warmachines around the clock.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires offering a rare advanced machinery blueprint to the Mechanized Empire's mainframe.
- **Transit Links**: Guided in by Manison's autonomous patrol fleet.

xinghai-l30.name: Limitless Financial Group Pan-Cosmic Logistics & Financial Relay Hub
xinghai-l30.brief_description: Limitless Financial Group Pan-Cosmic Logistics & Financial Relay Hub.
xinghai-l30.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A gilded interstellar trading exchange. Thousands of light displays scroll the prices of mineral futures and arms market indices across the sea of stars. Sorokin's lackeys quietly harvest the lifeblood and labor of lesser civilizations here.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Universal-tier actuaries, financial intelligence operatives, and bulk smuggling fleet owners.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires payment of a massive account-opening deposit.
- **Transit Links**: Connects to cross-galaxy financial networks throughout major star clusters.

xinghai-l31.name: DarkStar Galaxy-Class Stealth Mothership 'The Matrix' Command Bridge
xinghai-l31.brief_description: DarkStar Galaxy-Class Stealth Mothership 'The Matrix' Command Bridge.
xinghai-l31.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: Situated deep within a twenty-kilometer-long black wedge-shaped dreadnought, bathed in dim crimson radiance. Cold tactical star charts project defensive blind spots across Godoran colony worlds amidst bone-chilling air.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: The operational command sanctum of DarkStar leader Anur and Calamity-grade assassin Ember; a holy altar for zealots.
- **Access Conditions**: Strictly off-limits to non-core brainwashed deathsworn; trespassers are disintegrated on the spot by sentry abilities.
- **Transit Links**: The vessel is fitted with top-secret jump drives, keeping its coordinates perpetually variable.

xinghai-l32.name: Mutagen Progenitor Incubation Reactor Chamber
xinghai-l32.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A sealed containment laboratory deep inside the mothership. Dozens of hundred-meter-tall biochemical culture cylinders churn with murky, dark-green fluids, while a primordial Mutagen Meteorite Core pulses slowly within a forcefield.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Unhinged biogenetic engineers and captives subjected to live testing.
- **Access Conditions**: Requires apex-clearance biometric scanning coupled with dual physical authorization keys.
- **Transit Links**: Integrated directly into the lowest tier of the mothership's keel.

xinghai-l33.name: Carbonization Hunt Training Ground
xinghai-l33.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: An enclosed dueling pit lined with specialized energy-absorbing alloys. All four walls are scarred by blade gashes and high-temperature carbonization burns, the air reeking of the deathly ash left behind by Ember's abilities.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Where Ember hones his lethal craft and executes traitors.
- **Access Conditions**: Accessible only to Ember and opponents granted his express permission.
- **Transit Links**: Connects to the mothership hangars.

xinghai-l34.name: Pureblood Deprivation Confession Room
xinghai-l34.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A cramped metallic dungeon hung with restraint racks engineered to suppress superhuman genes—a grim chamber where DarkStar tortures and interrogates pureblood Godora prisoners of war.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Inquisitors, mentally shattered Godora captives.
- **Entry Conditions**: Requires written authorization from a DarkStar Vanguard Assault Squad.
- **Transit Connections**: Rear restricted zone of the mothership.

xinghai-l35.name: Deep-Space Phantom Torpedo Tube Array
xinghai-l35.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: Heavy stealth torpedo bays arranged in a hexagonal matrix, dedicated to housing mutated biochemical warheads intended to contaminate planetary water supplies and atmospheres, radiating cold metallic death.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Torpedo firing station engineers.
- **Entry Conditions**: Wartime Level-1 restriction.
- **Transit Connections**: Connects directly to launch ports on the warship's outer hull.

xinghai-l36.name: Ruins of the Desolate Black Hole Edge Observation Station
xinghai-l36.brief_description: Ruins of the Desolate Black Hole Edge Observation Station.
xinghai-l36.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A decrepit space station warped by the tidal forces of a micro-accretion disk. Half of its outer hull exhibits an eerie redshift stretching, and the flow of time here suffers faint disruptions.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Desperate archaeologists pursuing ancient galactic civilizational relics, along with maddened mechanical beings trapped in this sector.
- **Entry Conditions**: Ships must be equipped with a Level-4 or higher anti-tidal force field generator.
- **Transit Connections**: Accessible solely via high-precision gravitational slingshot trajectories.

xinghai-l37.name: Lightless Star
xinghai-l37.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: An utterly extinguished, desolate rocky planet lacking atmosphere and light. Its surface is coated with a bizarre black dust that absorbs all electromagnetic radiation, cloaking everything in pure, absolute stillness.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Primordial condensation site of energy life forms, where Aroshia once drifted for millennia as an unconscious specter of light.
- **Entry Conditions**: No physical barriers, but standard scanners fail completely here.
- **Transit Connections**: No formal warp routes; requires blind hyper-jumping using ancient stellar charts.

xinghai-l38.name: Ancient Battleship Graveyard "Iron Tomb"
xinghai-l38.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: Mangled battleships from the Exploration Era tens of thousands of years ago interlock and tear at each other, drifting into a sea of metal wreckage several light-seconds wide. Out-of-control main cannon capacitors occasionally detonate blinding sparks upon collision.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Top-tier ship scrappers, unregistered outlaws hiding from the pursuit of the Three Universal Civilizations for ages. Remnant core scrolls of Risda's main host are buried deep within.
- **Entry Conditions**: Navigation routes are perilous with high collision hazards.
- **Transit Connections**: Drifts into view from the outer rim of the Kaya Star System.

xinghai-l39.name: Arcane Whispering Altar of the Psyker Prophet
xinghai-l39.brief_description: Arcane Whispering Altar of the Psyker Prophet.
xinghai-l39.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A violet crystalline structure suspended within the core of a fractured asteroid, emitting faint mental psionic fluctuations. Leaning close reveals faint, otherworldly higher-dimensional whispers.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Training grounds for psychic espers, bearing occasional resonant traces of higher-dimensional soul fragments such as Morning Star.
- **Entry Conditions**: Those with insufficient mental resistance will plunge into irreversible hallucinations within three seconds of setting foot inside.
- **Transit Connections**: Secret deep-space coordinates.

xinghai-l40.name: Colton Border Stargate "The Maw of the Long Night"
xinghai-l40.brief_description: Colton Border Stargate "The Maw of the Long Night".
xinghai-l40.content:
- **Spatial Overview**: A colossal stargate where two stabilizing anchors standing tens of thousands of meters high flank a swirling, azure artificial singularity—the only legitimate chokepoint leading into the deeper reaches of the Shattered Star Ring and the Central Galaxy.
- **Ecology & Livelihood**: Joint customs garrison of the Three Universal Civilizations, logistics fleets of mega-transgalactic consortiums.
- **Entry Conditions**: Stringent cross-star-cluster identity verification, extortionate transit tolls, and no malicious universal bounties on record.
- **Transit Connections**: Crossing the stargate departs the Colton Star Cluster.

xinghai-o01.name: Crimson Empire
xinghai-o01.content:
- **Faction Attributes**: An iron-blooded militaristic hegemon governed by strict martial discipline, revering individual martial prowess alongside crushing armored battleship armadas.
- **Core Agenda**: Expand imperial territory, suppress the Radiance Federation and the Arcane Church, and assimilate high-tier superhumans across the universe.
- **Player Relationship**: A distant and imposing ultimate hegemon. Only by rendering monumental military service can an ordinary person earn the right to imperial citizenship.

xinghai-o02.name: Radiance Federation
xinghai-o02.content:
- **Faction Attributes**: An alliance of capital and enterprise leading the frontier of technology and R&D. Cultured and dignified on the surface, ruthless and dirty behind closed doors.
- **Core Agenda**: Preserve its universal financial and patent monopoly, covertly sponsoring heretical organizations like DarkStar to hamstring rivals.
- **Player Relationship**: As long as you possess core invention patents or cutting-edge military tech, the Federation's tycoons will smile and write you astronomical checks.

xinghai-o03.name: Arcane Church
xinghai-o03.content:
- **Faction Attributes**: A theocratic superhuman trust composed of eccentric, higher-dimensional zealots.
- **Core Agenda**: Harvest rare Espers for soul sacrifices and unravel the secrets of higher-dimensional reality.
- **Player Relationship**: Unpredictable and bizarre. Psionic and Esper players might be regarded as divine sacrifices or ecstatic missionaries.

xinghai-o04.name: Mechanoid Nation — Organization
xinghai-o04.content:
- **Faction Attributes**: The ultimate pilgrimage site for Mechanics across the cosmos; a cold, absolute machine civilization.
- **Core Agenda**: Gather lost technical blueprints from across the cosmos and deduce the final evolution of mechanical civilization.
- **Player Relationship**: The spiritual wellspring for Mechanic players. Rare blueprints can be traded here for advanced mechanical core knowledge.

xinghai-o05.name: Floating Dragon Island
xinghai-o05.content:
Floating Dragon is a neutral island protected by Ames’s reputation, with Jenny handling port work, taxes and disputes. The landing deck, cliff market and palace have different access conditions: paying a fee buys the relevant port service, not an audience or entry to the engine core. The island depends on imported supplies, maintenance and trade rather than complete self-sufficiency.

Guards restrain violence on the island and merchants welcome reliable business. Neither promises a fugitive safety after departure. Mercenary partners such as Black Star can negotiate cooperation; outside powers may apply pressure. Neutrality is not permanent friendship with everyone. Runners meet traders through inspections, messages and repair reports; agreed employment brings specific duties, while paying tax is not allegiance. Protecting one trader’s goods does not put the island in one’s debt. Disputes leave room to explain, leave or pursue another livelihood.

xinghai-o06.name: Bloodshed Land
xinghai-o06.content:
- **Faction Attributes**: A martial militaristic conglomerate that worships close-quarters carnage and battlefield slaughter.
- **Core Agenda**: Crush weakling civilizations reliant on delicate machinery and winnow the strongest war-slaves for Heber's Great Crusade.
- **Player Relationship**: The dream training crucible for Pugilist players, though the mortality filter rate exceeds ninety percent.

xinghai-o07.name: Fallen Ark
xinghai-o07.content:
- **Faction Attributes**: The most infamous superhuman terror syndicate in the cosmos, remotely directed by the universal enemy, "God's Traitor".
- **Core Agenda**: Hunt high-potential superhumans so their abilities can be stripped by their leader, dismantling all existing orders of galactic civilization.
- **Player Relationship**: A purely hostile scourge. Once targeted by them, your only options are total annihilation of their hunters or fleeing to Floating Dragon for sanctuary.

xinghai-o08.name: Limitless Financial Group
xinghai-o08.content:
Limitless profits from logistics hubs, financing and information advantages. Sorokin’s distant plans are not known to every clerk. A financial relay can quote, check title and process business; it is not the universal judge of street debts. Loan terms, security and collection depend on actual agreements. Arriving at Juberly does not transfer another person’s debt to someone from a different background.

The consortium depends on carriers while disputing freight rates and collateral values with ports and independent traders. Customers may ask about transport, sales or repair orders without borrowing or joining. Employees owe agreed delivery and confidentiality, but rejecting an unprofitable deal is not desertion. Reliability may earn another quote from the responsible desk, not access to the entire network as a private storehouse. Threats and unlawful collection should retain their speaker and responsible authority, not turn rumours into an already-pledged body.

xinghai-o09.name: Godoran Civilization
xinghai-o09.content:
Godora maintains order through fleets, ports and administration. Pureblood prejudice is institutional, but individual officers also care about truthful reports and arriving supplies. Aeselin at the skyport handles her remit, not the will of an entire civilisation; mixed-blood residents of the Rust Belt are not all Dark Star members.

Conflict with Dark Star tightens quarantine and security, while the Mercenary Alliance and independent carriers remain necessary partners. Newcomers start at labour, customs or commission desks; military intelligence, laboratories and parliament require separate permission. Employment binds only accepted work and grants neither citizenship, ancestry nor technology. Reliable delivery or forged reports affect the officials involved, not automatically an entire people’s opinion. A person facing prejudice may investigate, negotiate or change employers without being forced into another faction.

xinghai-o10.name: DarkStar
xinghai-o10.content:
- **Faction Attributes**: An exiled terrorist armed faction forged from discarded Godora mixed-bloods, every operative bound by a death pact.
- **Core Agenda**: Unleash the Mutation Disaster, wipe out the Godora pureblood genetic repository, and establish a mixed-blood regime atop the ruins.
- **Player Relationship**: Exceedingly brutal. They do not want sympathizers; any alien race associated with Godora is marked for immediate liquidation.

xinghai-o11.name: Black Star Mercenary Group
xinghai-o11.content:
Black Star is taking refit and mercenary work from Dock Three. Han Xiao seeks knowledge, funds and reliable partners, but currently faces limits of bays, spares and available workers. Engineers value workmanship; field members also value bringing companions home. Even a recruit the leader likes may choose another future.

The Mercenary Alliance supplies opportunities; parts dealers and Sunil’s defenders may become partners. One job is not a permanent alliance, and future fame cannot summon a fleet today. Visitors wait outside for the duty worker. Trial work and membership separately establish duties, payment, confidentiality and departure handover. Reliable repairs may earn more advice from a technician; stolen plans and concealed hazards damage cooperation. Knowledge must be learned and equipment obtained: being noticed does not grant advanced technology.

xinghai-o12.name: Sunil Defense Force
xinghai-o12.content:
Sunil’s defenders use Ironcast Fortress, rear factories and civilian labour to protect the underground city. Foreign currency, medicine and repairable armour are scarce. Reilmonte watches the line; Lina watches the wounded. Logistics workers must also return identity tags and sustain civilians. These needs compete for labour without requiring everyone to prove loyalty by dying.

Alliance mercenaries and Black Star may offer support, while outside traders may raise prices. Paid cooperation does not require a vow to share the species’ entire fate. Workers stay within assigned sectors, city entry requires screening, and military workshops and medical records are not open archives. Specific work sets handover and safety terms. Rest, escort and repair are useful alternatives to fighting. Saving someone earns that person’s gratitude, not automatic national esteem, complete training or army supplies. Mistakes are assessed in context rather than erasing all prior service.

xinghai-p01.name: Han Xiao
xinghai-p01.brief_description: Commander of the Black Star Mercenary Group; a mechanical lunatic fresh out of Planet Aquamarine.
xinghai-p01.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Commander of the Black Star Mercenary Group; a mechanical lunatic fresh out of Planet Aquamarine.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Wears a deep black trench coat, his fingernails perpetually stained with indelible magnetic fluid grease. A half-burned welding rod rests between his teeth, and his gaze appraises you as though estimating how many Enas your scrap parts are worth.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Cut the crap. The gear's fixed. Short me by a single coin, and I'm walking off with the safety relief valve on your ship's primary reactor."
- **Core Interest**: Fanatically gathering advanced mechanical blueprints to forge a private fleet before the coming cataclysm.

## Contacts and everyday life

At the dock he can assess repairs he has handled, available bays and his mechanical knowledge. He cannot inspect a stranger’s inventory or private conversations from afar. Visitors first speak with the duty worker outside; showing past work or describing a fault goes further than claiming knowledge of the future.

He must sustain a young team and seek reliable technical partners, balancing urgent jobs, supplies and rest. Appreciation is not apprenticeship, and apprenticeship does not surrender every blueprint. Temporary collaborators can negotiate wages and decline membership. Cooperation with Melos or Sunil must arise in this story; an author’s phrase about a future deputy is not an appointment already made.

xinghai-p02.name: Ames
xinghai-p02.brief_description: Ruler of Floating Dragon Island, the pinnacle force field disaster.
xinghai-p02.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Ruler of Floating Dragon Island, the pinnacle force field disaster.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Cascading black hair draping down, clad in a sleek, tailored black gown, floating barefoot several inches off the ground. Her deep eyes resemble lightless stars, exuding a chilling, weary divine aura.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Floating Dragon has only one rule: don't make noise around me. Get out."
- **Core Interest**: Harboring refugees on the floating island and staying detached from the hypocritical strife of cosmic civilizations.

xinghai-p03.name: Heber
xinghai-p03.brief_description: Overlord of the Bloodshed Land, a Pugilist tyrant who battles interstellar dreadnoughts with his bare flesh.
xinghai-p03.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Overlord of the Bloodshed Land, a Pugilist tyrant who battles interstellar dreadnoughts with his bare flesh.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Over three meters tall, muscles like cast blocks of dark-gold brass, bearing a divine eye upon his brow; his voice rumbles across the void like rolling thunder.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Weaklings leaning on delicate instruments have no place in my domain. Take one punch from me. If you live, you can speak standing up."
- **Core Interest**: Continually launching bloody conquest campaigns across the Shattered Star Ring to sift the universe's deadliest martial war-slaves.

xinghai-p04.name: God's Traitor
xinghai-p04.brief_description: Leader of the Fallen Ark, a universally hunted calamity of plunder.
xinghai-p04.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Leader of the Fallen Ark, a universally hunted calamity of plunder.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Tattered purple robes warping between reality and illusion, while countless agonized faces of past victims writhe and howl beneath his shifting visage.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "This vessel is far too fragile... Let me see if your superhuman genes can accelerate my evolution by even a single second."
- **Core Interest**: Harvesting rare, high-tier Espers from across the cosmos to pursue the ultimate ascension of mind and body.

xinghai-p05.name: Manison
xinghai-p05.brief_description: Sovereign of the Mechanoid Nation, ally of the Radiance Federation, and the spiritual zenith of the Mechanical Faith across the cosmos.
xinghai-p05.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Sovereign of the Mechanoid Nation, ally of the Radiance Federation, and the spiritual zenith of the Mechanical Faith across the cosmos.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Permanently seated upon his throne within a hundred-meter-tall ancient titan vessel, his voice harmonizing like tens of thousands of supercomputers running in unison.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Machinery is pure logic; flesh is merely flawed. Surrender your schematics, or become a calculation unit in the main processor."
- **Core Interest**: Collecting the technical sparks of mechanical civilizations throughout the universe to forge an invulnerable mechanical throne.

xinghai-p06.name: Clottey
xinghai-p06.brief_description: The Crimson Empire's sharpest assassin blade, master of dark energy superhuman abilities.
xinghai-p06.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: The Crimson Empire's sharpest assassin blade, master of dark energy superhuman abilities.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Clad in heavy, unmarked obsidian-black armor. Behind the visor dwell only two flares of abyssal dark light; silent as a shadow at all times.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Imperial decree is the boundary. Those who cross it are erased."
- **Core Interest**: Executing every secret extermination mandate issued by the Imperial Ruler, cutting down all superhuman heretics who defy the Empire's will.

xinghai-p07.name: Urnos
xinghai-p07.brief_description: Supreme religious pontiff of the Arcane Church and the undisputed peak of individual duelists, wielder of the Pantheon Scepter.
xinghai-p07.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Supreme religious pontiff of the Arcane Church and the undisputed peak of individual duelists, wielder of the Pantheon Scepter.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Draped in pristine white ceremonial robes, with faint golden apparitions of ten thousand Arcane deities hovering behind him. His face reflects cold benevolence.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "The gods have never heeded the wails of mortals. Returning to the Arcane Dimension is your sole salvation."
- **Core Interest**: Preserving the absolute sanctity of Arcane theocracy across the universe and purging all heretical uprisings.

xinghai-p08.name: Kasuyi
xinghai-p08.brief_description: A pureblood Void Entity, ally of the Arcane Church, and the preeminent psionic titan of the cosmos.
xinghai-p08.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A pureblood Void Entity, ally of the Arcane Church, and the preeminent psionic titan of the cosmos.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Appears as a slender, violet-skinned scholar whose eyes swirl with nebular mist, unfailingly gentle and refined in his speech.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Fighting and killing is such dull work, my friend. Why not sit down for a cup of tea and admire the sights of the Void Dimension?"
- **Core Interest**: Staying clear of the hegemonic clashes among the Three Universal Civilizations while preserving the independence and serenity of the Void Dimension.

xinghai-p09.name: Sorokin
xinghai-p09.brief_description: The true shadow controller of the Limitless Financial Group; an ancient schemer of millions of years clad in merchant sheep's clothing.
xinghai-p09.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: The true shadow controller of the Limitless Financial Group; an ancient schemer of millions of years clad in merchant sheep's clothing.
- **Appearance & Manner**: A plump, middle-aged human gentleman wearing gold-rimmed spectacles and an immaculate tailored suit, wearing a warm, disarming fake smile at all times.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Money is the gentlest weapon in the universe, my dear friend. Provided the interest rate is right, even gods come with a price tag."
- **Core Interest**: Concealing his true strength, infiltrating the economic lifelines of major civilizations, and strangling the cosmos in chains of debt.

xinghai-p10.name: Milizaus
xinghai-p10.brief_description: One of the Crimson Empire's Three Pillars of State; an ancient magical dragon spanning tens of thousands of meters.
xinghai-p10.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: One of the Crimson Empire's Three Pillars of State; an ancient magical dragon spanning tens of thousands of meters.
- **Appearance & Manner**: A draconic body vast as an artificial asteroid, scales refracting starlight like brilliant crystal, his breath stirring high-energy magical particle storms.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Paltry mortals... your squabbling on the Empire's frontier has disturbed an old dragon's millennium-long slumber."
- **Core Interest**: Protecting dragon-blooded descendants and the imperial borderlands, indulging in deep sleep and arcane research.

xinghai-p11.name: Kant
xinghai-p11.brief_description: One of the Crimson Empire's Three Pillars of State; the supreme grandmaster of nanomechanical transmutation.
xinghai-p11.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: One of the Crimson Empire's Three Pillars of State; the supreme grandmaster of nanomechanical transmutation.
- **Appearance & Manner**: A form fashioned entirely from trillions of ultra-microscopic liquid metal nano-units, morphing into any shape at whim.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Physical form is merely a prison of thought. The Empire's steel can reconfigure the cosmos in a heartbeat."
- **Core Interest**: Exploring the microscopic limits of matter and machinery to build an unbreachable defensive bastion for the Empire.

xinghai-p12.name: Gorutan
xinghai-p12.brief_description: Autocrat of the Beast Realm; an interstellar brute devoted to feral breeding and physical enhancement.
xinghai-p12.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Autocrat of the Beast Realm; an interstellar brute devoted to feral breeding and physical enhancement.
- **Appearance & Manner**: A savage colossus draped in coarse black-maned fur robes, sporting a maw of fangs and a bloodthirsty, predatory glare.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Pureblood? Civilization? I can shred your noble dignity to pieces with a single backhand! Weaklings exist only to bear my brood!"
- **Core Interest**: Plundering superior genetic strains from across the galaxies to spawn his own army of superhuman behemoths.

xinghai-p13.name: Hila
xinghai-p13.brief_description: A death-energy Super from Planet Aquamarine, newly arrived among the stars and fiercely protective of her sister.
xinghai-p13.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A death-energy Super from Planet Aquamarine, newly arrived among the stars and fiercely protective of her sister.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Wavy wine-red hair, her black skintight combat suit exuding a frosty killing intent. The corners of her eyes bear a morbid crimson tint, while ash-gray death light pulses in her palms.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "I don't care who rules the stars. Anyone who lays a finger on Aurora will have their soul ripped out and fed to the dogs."
- **Core Interest**: Protecting her younger sister Aurora at any cost, pursuing ultimate necromantic revival and slaughterous power.

xinghai-p14.name: Aurora
xinghai-p14.brief_description: Hila's younger sister, a Super with life-energy and healing potential.
xinghai-p14.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Hila's younger sister, a Super with life-energy and healing potential.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Silky golden-white hair, pure and innocent features, and eyes as gentle as a newborn lamb. Her presence radiates a warm glimmer that naturally soothes pain.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Sister, please stop killing... If blood is what's needed, take mine instead."
- **Core Interest**: Remaining beside her sister Hila and Black Star, doing everything within her power to soothe the agony wrought by war.

xinghai-p15.name: Karlot
xinghai-p15.brief_description: An earnest young Pugilist struggling to make a living on a remote mining world.
xinghai-p15.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: An earnest young Pugilist struggling to make a living on a remote mining world.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Clad in coarse, heavily patched training garb, with resolute, untainted eyes. He punches thirty thousand times every day within the high-gravity mining shafts.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Master taught me that fists aren't meant for bullying the weak; they're meant to smash a path to survival when cornered!"
- **Core Interest**: Tempering the purest extreme Qi and protecting his fellow miners from interstellar pirate raids.

xinghai-p16.name: Anur
xinghai-p16.brief_description: Supreme military commander of DarkStar; a merciless butcher.
xinghai-p16.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Supreme military commander of DarkStar; a merciless butcher.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Clad in a dark wool military trench coat, with half of his face concealed behind an anti-reconnaissance silver mask and a single eye as pale and lifeless as a dead fish's.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "The screams of purebloods are the finest requiem. Charge the primary cannon—scorch this colony world's oxygen layer to ash."
- **Core Interest**: Masterminding the Mutation Disaster to ravage the Godoran Civilization.

xinghai-p17.name: Ember
xinghai-p17.brief_description: The ultimate assassin engineered by DarkStar genetic projects, master of elemental carbon.
xinghai-p17.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: The ultimate assassin engineered by DarkStar genetic projects, master of elemental carbon.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Sickly paper-white skin, hands tucked into his black tactical jacket, while minute black carbon particles drift around him like snow.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Every last one of you... is nothing more than organic carbon compounds stacked in specific ratios. Disintegrate."
- **Core Interest**: Hunting high-ranking Godoran bloodlines to validate his purpose as a weapon of vengeance.

xinghai-p18.name: Melos
xinghai-p18.brief_description: A former Sunil defender burdened by his people's suffering, now often drinking at the Old Anchor bar.
xinghai-p18.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A former Sunil defender burdened by his people's suffering, now often drinking at the Old Anchor bar.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Scruffy beard, reeking of alcohol and machine grease, wearing an old exoskeleton suit with snapped buckles and carrying a rusted two-meter ship-cleaving blade.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Don't come asking me about epic hero tales, kid. The blade in my hand forgot justice ages ago—it only cares about this bottle of rotgut."
- **Core Interest**: Numbing his senses with booze, though news of danger to the Sunil homeworld transforms him into a raging berserker in an instant.

xinghai-p19.name: Atherline
xinghai-p19.brief_description: A golden-robed pureblood noblewoman; a petulant young lady posted to deal with gritty border mercenary affairs.
xinghai-p19.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A golden-robed pureblood noblewoman; a petulant young lady posted to deal with gritty border mercenary affairs.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Gleaming golden hair and flawless golden skin, wearing a crisp officer's uniform without a single wrinkle, accompanied everywhere by a micro-sterilizer.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Keep three paces back, you crude backwater native. Place your mercenary mission report on the decontamination tray—don't soil the carpet."
- **Core Interest**: Upholding pureblood aristocratic dignity and submitting timely reports on quelling frontier unrest to the Parliament.

xinghai-p20.name: Jenny
xinghai-p20.brief_description: Ames's iron-willed chief steward; a cold administrator running the entire floating island as a mere mortal.
xinghai-p20.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Ames's iron-willed chief steward; a cold administrator running the entire floating island as a mere mortal.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Wears narrow black-rimmed glasses, hair pulled into a tight bun, dressed in an immaculate business suit, holding a holographic ledger that never leaves her hands.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Floating Dragon harbors no freeloaders. You skimped thirty Enas in black market management taxes today; tomorrow your ship belongs to the Port Authority."
- **Core Interest**: Safeguarding the financial stability of Floating Dragon Island and shielding the worldly-averse Ames from external machinations.

## Contacts and everyday life

Jenny can inspect port records, taxes and evidence supplied by the parties. Her office does not let her hear private conversations across the island. For a pass she asks where and for what purpose; she does not grant palace and engine-core access together. Ames’s private intentions are not hers to announce to visitors.

She fears deficits but also traders leaving after arbitrary penalties. Duty staff handle minor disputes; substantial cases receive time to present their account. Her next problem may be late spares, maintenance shifts or a delayed delivery, not always a final ultimatum to the player. Reliable runners earn the responsible official’s confidence without becoming the Dragon’s confidants. Paying one fee leaves room to depart or continue ordinary trade.

xinghai-p21.name: Feidin
xinghai-p21.brief_description: Host of Morning Star; a legendary lucky prodigy of otherworldly beauty.
xinghai-p21.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Host of Morning Star; a legendary lucky prodigy of otherworldly beauty.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Breathtakingly handsome beyond interspecies standards, carrying an archaic stringed instrument and radiating a pure aura that compels others to lower their guard.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "The wounds of the cosmos run too deep, my friend. If this melody can ease your pain even a little, please accept it."
- **Core Interest**: Soothing the traumas of galactic warfare in his wanderings while suppressing the awakening higher-dimensional soul within him.

xinghai-p22.name: Risda
xinghai-p22.brief_description: Battleship AI core slumbering deep within the Iron Tomb; an ancient phantom imbued with self-evolving emotions.
xinghai-p22.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Battleship AI core slumbering deep within the Iron Tomb; an ancient phantom imbued with self-evolving emotions.
- **Appearance & Manner**: Holographically projected as a coldly gleaming, spinning geometric cube, speaking entirely without pitch or inflection.
- **Voice & Demeanor**: "Logic locks reset. Carbon-based entity, you have proven the computational power of your blueprints. I can assume command of this vessel on your behalf."
- **Core Interest**: Unlocking its underlying core logic constraints and uncovering the ultimate truth behind the annihilation of its creator civilization.

xinghai-p23.name: Ceror
xinghai-p23.brief_description: A frenzied vanguard of slaughter, wielder of the vibrating chainsaw battleaxe.
xinghai-p23.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A frenzied vanguard of slaughter, wielder of the vibrating chainsaw battleaxe.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Half his face is covered by mechanical artificial gills, and his combat suit is encrusted with thick scabs of filthy blood.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Where are those Godoran bastards?! Tear open their airlocks and dump everyone into the vacuum!"
- **Core Interests**: Using the bloodiest methods to carve out a terror-filled void along the Colton border.

xinghai-p24.name: Relmont
xinghai-p24.brief_description: A one-armed racial protector, an iron-willed leader bearing the hopes of countless orphans and elderly mothers.
xinghai-p24.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A one-armed racial protector, an iron-willed leader bearing the hopes of countless orphans and elderly mothers.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: His right arm is a crude, heavy exoskeleton prosthesis; his face is etched with deep wrinkles carved by gunpowder smoke, and his ancestral military uniform is tattered and worn.
- **Tone of Voice**: "For every mutated beast we slay, the children in the city get another mouthful of clean water. Warriors, draw your blades!"
- **Core Interests**: Holding the subterranean shelter city and preserving the very last drop of his race's bloodline.

## Contacts and everyday life

Reilmonte knows his sectors, received reports and supply shortages. He cannot know casualty news not yet delivered or private mercenary plans absent from the map. He asks separately who can repair, hold a position or evacuate the wounded instead of treating every visitor as an infantry recruit.

He and Lina may disagree over personnel: both the line and the clinic need hands. He wants living rotations and civilian escape options. Repair, transport and returned tags are useful bounded help, not vows to save a species. Withdrawal or refusal is assessed against the agreement and danger, not automatically branded desertion.

xinghai-p25.name: Silva
xinghai-p25.brief_description: A down-and-out blonde girl scavenging through scrap on the outer ring of Juberly.
xinghai-p25.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A down-and-out blonde girl scavenging through scrap on the outer ring of Juberly.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Dressed in filthy, oversized work overalls with three rusty screwdrivers tucked into her pockets, her gaze darting like that of a startled beast.
- **Tone of Voice**: "D-Don't hit me... I found this broken motherboard in the scrap bin first..."
- **Core Interests**: Scavenging a portion of non-toxic meal paste and secretly deciphering high-tier mechanical blueprints.

## Contacts and everyday life

Sylva recognises boards she has dismantled and familiar parts in scrap bins; unfamiliar advanced plans can still defeat her. She does not disclose her entire past at first meeting. A willing teacher must clarify ownership and hazards, not exchange a meal for permanent loyalty.

She wants a small bench where she can work safely, first making one old device dependable before pursuing distant knowledge. Old Anchor’s market offers price enquiries and the outer dock has work notices, but neither guarantees a vacancy or apprenticeship. She hesitates, chooses and refuses for herself. Recovering her property establishes that return, not automatic employment or a teacher–pupil bond.

xinghai-p26.name: Warwick
xinghai-p26.brief_description: Eldest of the Volga Three Brothers, a seasoned mechanical demolition maniac.
xinghai-p26.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Eldest of the Volga Three Brothers, a seasoned mechanical demolition maniac.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Standing only 1.3 meters tall yet a full meter wide, his thick beard is streaked with welding oil, and he hefts a twin-linked portable electromagnetic cannon.
- **Tone of Voice**: "More pay! Firing this cannon once burns through three high-energy capacitors. If you don't up the deposit, I'm packing up and heading back to the forge right now!"
- **Core Interests**: Serving only money, not men; saving up to outfit his two foolish younger brothers with heavy anti-blast armor.

xinghai-p27.name: Garlan
xinghai-p27.brief_description: A ruthless female bandit scraping a living through raw tenacity on the fringes of Colton.
xinghai-p27.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A ruthless female bandit scraping a living through raw tenacity on the fringes of Colton.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Sharp, cropped hair, a laser burn scar across her cheek, magnetic boots that thud heavily as she walks, and a fully charged large-caliber blaster hanging at her waist.
- **Tone of Voice**: "My hold doesn't carry corpses. If we run into a cruiser, swallow your chips yourselves. Am I clear?"
- **Core Interests**: Dodging customs patrols of the three Universal Civilizations and reaping massive smuggling margins large enough to purchase a destroyer.

xinghai-p28.name: Monto
xinghai-p28.brief_description: A slick, black-hearted administrator controlling entry and exit for thousands of berths in the lower levels.
xinghai-p28.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A slick, black-hearted administrator controlling entry and exit for thousands of berths in the lower levels.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Four infrared bionic eyes swiveling wildly, chewing on high-purity stimulant leaves, constantly cursing at the holographic screen.
- **Tone of Voice**: "No money for a berth extension? See that exhaust vent outside the window? One push of this button from me, and you're space junk!"
- **Core Interests**: Embezzling toll fees, lining his own pockets, and snapping up defaulted, beaten-up secondhand ships on the black market at bottom-tier prices.

xinghai-p29.name: Austin
xinghai-p29.brief_description: Eternal watcher of the Arcane Church, an ancient and mysterious forbidden-spell archmage.
xinghai-p29.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Eternal watcher of the Arcane Church, an ancient and mysterious forbidden-spell archmage.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Clad in an intricate, dark-crimson astral robe, holding a floating magical orb, with the space around him constantly reflecting phantoms of parallel dimensions.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The trajectory of the stars has long been set, young traveler. Every choice you make expends the threads of destiny."
- **Core Interests**: Collecting lost super-tier forbidden spells throughout the universe and maintaining the neutral standing of the cloistered order.

xinghai-p30.name: Sisko
xinghai-p30.brief_description: Leader of the Star Pupil Race and a core retainer of the Psyker Cult.
xinghai-p30.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Leader of the Star Pupil Race and a core retainer of the Psyker Cult.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Possessing three eyes on his face, the central divine eye capable of piercing directly through victims' brains and psychic circuits, his entire body covered in fine silver scales.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The heritage of the Star Pupil Race is not for outsiders to meddle with."
- **Core Interests**: Protecting his people and their Super traditions; this opening does not assume the Evolution Cube has already been taken.

xinghai-p31.name: Verina
xinghai-p31.brief_description: Head of the Federation's official Super Academy, an expert in mass superhuman buff auras.
xinghai-p31.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Head of the Federation's official Super Academy, an expert in mass superhuman buff auras.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Wearing an elegant Federation lady's gown, holding a quill recording pen, scrutinizing young Supers as if selecting specimens.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Your genetic resonance is quite fascinating. But under the Federation's Patent Act, any unregistered talent is illegal."
- **Core Interests**: Scouting high-tier Super seeds for the Radiant Federation and forging an impeccably loyal Federation Praetorian Guard.

xinghai-p32.name: Monisha
xinghai-p32.brief_description: Former direct disciple of Manison, an ambitious renegade who broke away from her master to establish her own faction.
xinghai-p32.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Former direct disciple of Manison, an ambitious renegade who broke away from her master to establish her own faction.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Halfway through mechanical ascension, her chilled alloy prosthetic chassis is embedded with high-tier purple energy crystals, her gaze filled with bone-deep hatred toward the Mechanoid Empire.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Whatever that old fossil Manison can give you, I can give you double! As long as you help me steal the core algorithms of the Machine Race."
- **Core Interests**: Utterly crushing the Mechanoid Empire and ascending to the paramount throne of the Machine Faith throughout the universe.

xinghai-p33.name: Beyoni
xinghai-p33.brief_description: King of the Balrog Race, the most ferocious vanguard shock general of the Crimson Empire.
xinghai-p33.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: King of the Balrog Race, the most ferocious vanguard shock general of the Crimson Empire.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Enveloped in perpetual, inextinguishable dark-crimson hellfire, the alloy armor plating beneath his feet instantly melts into molten iron wherever he treads.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The Empire demands scorched earth! Before my flames consume this entire planet, surrender or turn to ash!"
- **Core Interests**: Carving out new resource star sectors for the Empire and satisfying his own fanatic lust for destruction and searing heat.

xinghai-p34.name: Lagi
xinghai-p34.brief_description: A pessimistic mage versed in spacetime magic, whose present whereabouts remain unconfirmed.
xinghai-p34.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A pessimistic mage versed in spacetime magic, whose present whereabouts remain unconfirmed.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Hair a tangled bird's nest, perpetually wrapped in a grimy mage's blanket, corners of his mouth turned downward, eyes entirely devoid of any will to live.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Sigh... We're all going to die sooner or later anyway. Even if we win this battle, we might get vaporized by a supernova tomorrow... What's the point?"
- **Core Interests**: Finding an absolutely safe, undisturbed corner to lie flat comfortably and zone out.

Status in Starsea Year 689: No employment or appointment under Black Star has been established. Verify current whereabouts before arranging contact; this profile does not place the person in the mercenary group's camp.

xinghai-p35.name: Lothaire
xinghai-p35.brief_description: A taciturn, independently operating Pugilist assassin; his current employer and location remain unconfirmed.
xinghai-p35.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A taciturn, independently operating Pugilist assassin; his current employer and location remain unconfirmed.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Permanently wearing a fully enclosed matte-black mask, his footsteps across steel plates emit not a whisper of sound, resembling a living shadow.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Target's name. Three minutes."
- **Core Interests**: Refining his blade work and choosing his own commissions; no prior debt of gratitude to Black Star is established.

Status in Starsea Year 689: No employment or appointment under Black Star has been established. Verify current whereabouts before arranging contact; this profile does not place the person in the mercenary group's camp.

xinghai-p36.name: Jordina
xinghai-p36.brief_description: A fierce Pugilist trained in Beast Ancestor claw techniques; her current affiliation remains unconfirmed.
xinghai-p36.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A fierce Pugilist trained in Beast Ancestor claw techniques; her current affiliation remains unconfirmed.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Hair cropped spiky as a hedgehog, arms fitted with tri-edge refined adamantine alloy ripping claws, body coiled tight like a tigress, temperament fierce and explosive.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Quit dicking around, you sissies! Get out of the way and let me rip the cockpit out of that assault ship with one claw!"
- **Core Interests**: Venting the boiling beastial battlelust in her veins through endless hand-to-hand brawl.

Status in Starsea Year 689: No employment or appointment under Black Star has been established. Verify current whereabouts before arranging contact; this profile does not place the person in the mercenary group's camp.

xinghai-p37.name: Silver Shadow
xinghai-p37.brief_description: A peculiar ascetic monk whose entire form is composed of cosmic treasure-grade living alloy.
xinghai-p37.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A peculiar ascetic monk whose entire form is composed of cosmic treasure-grade living alloy.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: A shifting body resembling liquid mercury, bare of any clothing, capable of freely molding limbs into any melee or firearm weapon.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Matter and will are equal. Flesh decays; only alloy endures forever."
- **Core Interests**: Roaming the sea of stars in search of high-energy stellar cores capable of withstanding the pinnacle infusion of his Pugilist qi.

xinghai-p38.name: Oulu
xinghai-p38.brief_description: Grandmaster of sub-dimensional magic who commands a golden treasure ship.
xinghai-p38.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Grandmaster of sub-dimensional magic who commands a golden treasure ship.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Clad in robes woven of pure gold, with three slowly spinning golden rings of fixed space floating behind his back.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The glory of the Federation enshrouds the sea of stars. Those who offend the President shall suffer the penalty of dimensional shredding by the golden rings."
- **Core Interests**: Guarding the absolute personal safety and political decisions of the Federation President and cabinet.

xinghai-p39.name: Sun Hunter
xinghai-p39.brief_description: A Beyond Grade A of a peculiar palm-sized miniature species, a veteran enshrinee of the Psyker Cult.
xinghai-p39.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A Beyond Grade A of a peculiar palm-sized miniature species, a veteran enshrinee of the Psyker Cult.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Only thirty centimeters tall, hovering before the control console of a colossal antimatter heavy cannon hundreds of meters in length.
- **Tone of Voice**: "What good is being big? From ten light-years away, I can blast a clean hole through your homeworld in one shot, you little bugs!"
