- **Core Interests**: Collecting rare heavy-nucleus isotope fuels across the universe to refit his world-ending heavy cannon.

xinghai-p40.name: Mercer
xinghai-p40.brief_description: Vanguard Pugilist of the Psyker Cult, progenitor of the gray-furred beastman lineage.
xinghai-p40.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Vanguard Pugilist of the Psyker Cult, progenitor of the gray-furred beastman lineage.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: A terrifying mountain of flesh seven meters tall, muscles bulging like hills, wielding a star-shattering heavy club over ten meters long.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Roar—! The divine oracle says that today, every single one of you gets turned into meat paste!"
- **Core Interests**: Executing the temple's bloody conquest edicts and devouring the high-tier super flesh and blood of the strong.

xinghai-p41.name: Raven
xinghai-p41.brief_description: An ancient mentor recorded in Imperial histories, present in this opening only as a historical record.
xinghai-p41.content:
Starsea Year 689 archive: This entry preserves a historical description, not a living presence, completed revival or current residence. It may be cited as a record, but does not authorize an appearance.

- **Identity & Movements**: An ancient mentor recorded in Imperial histories, present in this opening only as a historical record.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Dressed in a dignified, classical court black gauze gown, her benevolent eyes tempered by supreme majesty that has seen through tens of thousands of years of rise and fall.
- **Voice Quoted in Old Records**: "Little Black, your use of dark energy is still so impetuous... The blade of the Empire ought to remain sheathed."
- **Core Interests**: Historical accounts describe a concern for later Imperial generations. This is a past motive, not an available present-day commission.

xinghai-p42.name: Hilbert
xinghai-p42.brief_description: An ancient spatial-magic scholar in old Psyker records, present in this opening only as a historical record.
xinghai-p42.content:
Starsea Year 689 archive: This entry preserves a historical description, not a living presence, completed revival or current residence. It may be cited as a record, but does not authorize an appearance.

- **Identity & Movements**: An ancient spatial-magic scholar in old Psyker records, present in this opening only as a historical record.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Half of his body is submerged within spatial rifts; whenever he speaks, surrounding space ripples outward in layered shocks.
- **Voice Quoted in Old Records**: "Dimensions are no cage; spacetime is but a tapestry. Mortals, why trap yourselves in a single corner of the star field?"
- **Core Interests**: Old records associate him with spatial research. No awakening, appearance or personal teaching is established in this opening.

xinghai-p43.name: Hyperion
xinghai-p43.brief_description: A rogue mechanical ascension zealot bearing the blood debt of his annihilated homeworld.
xinghai-p43.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A rogue mechanical ascension zealot bearing the blood debt of his annihilated homeworld.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: His entire flesh form replaced by black heavy colonization armor, an antimatter furnace roaring wildly within his chest, like an iron fiendgod.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Flesh is a lie; civilization is ash! Only the unyielding cold iron can exact vengeance upon the sea of stars!"
- **Core Interests**: Intercepting and slaughtering any hegemonic fleet plundering weaker civilizations, and developing world-ending autonomous mechas.

xinghai-p44.name: Pangolin
xinghai-p44.brief_description: A Primordial Pugilist remembered in old histories, retained here only as a historical figure.
xinghai-p44.content:
Starsea Year 689 archive: This entry preserves a historical description, not a living presence, completed revival or current residence. It may be cited as a record, but does not authorize an appearance.

- **Identity & Movements**: A Primordial Pugilist remembered in old histories, retained here only as a historical figure.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Wrists and ankles bound with crude ancestral iron bangles, his chest crisscrossed with deep scars left by divine-demonic wars tens of thousands of years ago.
- **Voice Quoted in Old Records**: "The debts owed by the Three Universal Civilizations shall be settled one by one! This old man's fists haven't rusted yet!"
- **Core Interests**: Old histories preserve his anger toward dominant powers. No revival, present campaign or allegiance to a current leader is established here.

xinghai-p45.name: Beiger
xinghai-p45.brief_description: A widely learned Mystery-type researcher whose current circumstances and personal contacts remain unconfirmed.
xinghai-p45.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A widely learned Mystery-type researcher whose current circumstances and personal contacts remain unconfirmed.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Flowing silver hair, holding an astrological abacus, perpetually drifting along the rim of the cosmos aboard an ancient starship.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The blank spaces on an old star chart can matter more than its recorded routes."
- **Core Interests**: Pursuing mystical studies and ancient interstellar lore; neither an association-building project nor cooperation with Black Star is established.

xinghai-p46.name: Oathkeeper
xinghai-p46.brief_description: A secretive interstellar operative who has long sought lost ancient records.
xinghai-p46.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A secretive interstellar operative who has long sought lost ancient records.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Clad in a tattered linen ascetic robe, face hidden beneath the deep shadow of his hood, speaking in a calm, gentle manner.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Old records leave many gaps. I do not put faith in a claim without evidence."
- **Core Interests**: Collecting credible leads on ancient civilizations and lost legacies; cooperation with Black Star and access to his special permissions are not established facts.

xinghai-p47.name: Dillon
xinghai-p47.brief_description: A powerful Pugilist associated with old accounts of the Underworld; his current status and any route of contact remain unverified.
xinghai-p47.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A powerful Pugilist associated with old accounts of the Underworld; his current status and any route of contact remain unverified.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Helmet perched crookedly, chewing sideways on a blade of grass, eyes brimming with unvarnished contempt and provocation.
- **Tone of Voice**: "That's it? That pathetic force of yours isn't even enough to scratch an itch for me! Did the Three Civilizations skip breakfast, you useless trash?!"
- **Core Interests**: Old accounts describe a combative, provocative temperament; they do not establish a present office in the Underworld or permission to summon him into battle.

xinghai-p48.name: Traveler
xinghai-p48.brief_description: An elusive spatial Super mercenary skilled in spatial escape and fel-energy corruption.
xinghai-p48.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: An elusive spatial Super mercenary skilled in spatial escape and fel-energy corruption.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Oozing foul, dark-green fel juice from his entire body, cloaked in a tattered star chart mantle, his whereabouts entirely unpredictable.
- **Tone of Voice**: "As long as the price is right, what do I care whether a planet lives or dies? If you can't catch me, shut your mouth!"
- **Core Interests**: Profiting from individual commissions and dangerous work; any employer must be established through actual contact and agreement in this period.

xinghai-p49.name: Nago
xinghai-p49.brief_description: A bloated veteran bureaucrat entrenched in Juberly Hub for decades, dealing with both the underworld and the law.
xinghai-p49.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A bloated veteran bureaucrat entrenched in Juberly Hub for decades, dealing with both the underworld and the law.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Corpulent build, wearing loosely draped golden robes, fingers adorned with energy crystal rings accepted as bribes from various star systems.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Godora made the rules, but the interpretation belongs to me. Add another twenty thousand Enas in processing fees, and your contraband becomes diplomatic cargo on the spot."
- **Core Interests**: Amassing a hefty retirement fund and covertly splitting spoils with smuggling flotillas of all stripes.

xinghai-p50.name: Charles
xinghai-p50.brief_description: Sorokin's chief comprador planted in the fringe star cluster, a vampiric actuary.
xinghai-p50.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Sorokin's chief comprador planted in the fringe star cluster, a vampiric actuary.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Silver-gray hair, a smart monocle that intermittently flashes green stock-market data, fingers clicking with surgical precision on a pure-gold abacus.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The Sunils have three days left before repayment is due. If they can't cough up the Enas, their No. 3 underground reservoir becomes collateral for the consortium."
- **Core Interests**: Forcing bankrupt civilizations to surrender core mining rights and plunging refugees across the entire star cluster into perpetual debt abyss.

xinghai-p51.name: Sky-Breaking Ring
xinghai-p51.brief_description: Branch commander of the cluster-tier powerhouse Sky Ring Army, a heavy-armored knight.
xinghai-p51.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: Branch commander of the cluster-tier powerhouse Sky Ring Army, a heavy-armored knight.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Clad in silver-white ring-patterned heavy armor, three defensive barrier rings constantly spinning behind his back, demeanor imposing and stern.
- **Tone of Voice**: "When Sky Ring takes a contract, even gods must pay toll. Breach the contract, and your starship will be snapped in two along with everyone aboard."
- **Core Interests**: Safeguarding Sky Ring's monopoly on major contracts in the Colton Star Cluster and suppressing emerging small mercenary groups.

xinghai-p52.name: Iron Skull
xinghai-p52.brief_description: A heavy-industrial weapons fanatic whose body has undergone extreme cybernetic conversion.
xinghai-p52.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A heavy-industrial weapons fanatic whose body has undergone extreme cybernetic conversion.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Half of his skull has been replaced by an alloy braincase, and he carries a compact nuclear fusion arc ignition box on his back.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Blanket fire! I don't give a damn about bullet trajectory points—I just want to see everything within five kilometers of the target turned to cinders!"
- **Core Interests**: Field-testing the heavy electromagnetic armor-piercing cannon freshly rolled off the line at the Purple Gold Stronghold.

xinghai-p53.name: Blood Fox
xinghai-p53.brief_description: A bloodthirsty female assassin relying on sheer speed to overpower foes, a veteran on the bounty boards.
xinghai-p53.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A bloodthirsty female assassin relying on sheer speed to overpower foes, a veteran on the bounty boards.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Donning a fox-shaped tactical visor, twin high-frequency vibrating shortblades strapped to her waist, moving with the eerie lightness of a falling leaf.
- **Tone of Voice**: "His heart was in his left chest. You were slow by 1.02 seconds. You owe me ten thousand Enas in bounty cut."
- **Core Interests**: Hunting the heads of pirate chieftains to buy high-priced gene potions that enhance her neural reflexes.

xinghai-p54.name: Old Anchor
xinghai-p54.brief_description: A one-legged retired veteran mercenary, the know-it-all of Juberly's underbelly.
xinghai-p54.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A one-legged retired veteran mercenary, the know-it-all of Juberly's underbelly.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: His metal crutch is heavily worn, his face scarred all over, half a cheap cigar permanently clamped between his lips, his gaze sharp as a razor.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Once you step through Old Anchor's door, muzzle down. Turn left outside if you want weapons; drain every drop of fake booze in that glass if you want to stay alive."
- **Core Interests**: Maintaining absolute neutrality for his bar and gathering compromising intel on all factions to keep himself alive.

## Contacts and everyday life

Old Anchor knows disputes in his bar, used goods he has handled and news people chose to share. He does not presume every stranger has a criminal record. He can explain the thresholds at the commission hall and dock; secrets may require checking the person and source, or may not be for sale.

He wants a place customers still choose for a drink, between smugglers, inspectors and retired mercenaries. His first boundary is no gunfire inside. Melos’s regular seat gives the proprietor no right to accept work for him. Under pressure he may close early, ask familiar customers to move stock or reject a dubious crate. The player can help or merely pay for a drink without being forced into another wager.

xinghai-p55.name: Old Urn
xinghai-p55.brief_description: An eccentric loner scraping out a living among the wreckage of ten-thousand-year-old warships.
xinghai-p55.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: An eccentric loner scraping out a living among the wreckage of ten-thousand-year-old warships.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Severely afflicted by radiation sickness, his festering facial skin patched over with lead-tape strips, wielding a modified bionic eye capable of identifying ancient alloy compositions at a glance.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Don't touch the main conduit of that cruiser... It'll blow. Kids these days don't even know the temper of ancient capacitors and still dare to go prospecting."
- **Core Interests**: Piecing together a working ancient star-destroyer power core inside this iron graveyard.

xinghai-p56.name: Lina
xinghai-p56.brief_description: A Sunil combat medic in white, battling severed limbs and acid burns day in and day out.
xinghai-p56.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A Sunil combat medic in white, battling severed limbs and acid burns day in and day out.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Her lab coat is splattered with dark-green mutated beast blood and crimson human blood; though her eyes are exhausted, her hands on the scalpel remain steady as stone.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Quit whining! Bite down on this iron sheet. I need to saw off your gangrenous bone in thirty seconds, or the venom hits your heart!"
- **Core Interests**: Fighting for every vial of antipyretic antivenom and saving more young fighters on the defensive lines.

## Contacts and everyday life

Lina can discuss injuries she has examined and medicine her clinic lacks, not read a stranger’s complete bodily statistics from a face. Records belong first to the patient. Even officers receive only what treatment and assignment genuinely require. Dressing wounds, resting and returning to the line need an honest explanation of risk.

She can teach instrument handling, stretcher cleaning and bottle identification; observing once does not qualify someone for surgery. Arguments with Reilmonte concern two real shortages, not a choice demanding the player declare one side right. She wants dependable evacuation and rest for her staff. One completed transfer settles that transfer. Gratitude for an injection does not automatically become a money debt or lifelong service.

xinghai-p57.name: Vic
xinghai-p57.brief_description: A hot-blooded hybrid youth hiding in the sewers.
xinghai-p57.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A hot-blooded hybrid youth hiding in the sewers.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Clad in ragged burlap, face smeared with anti-infrared mud, gripping a crude homemade plasma blasting cap in his hand.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The Purebloods feast on meat while we're taxed just for drinking acid rain! Even if I die, I'm taking down one of their orbital elevators!"
- **Core Interests**: Overthrowing Godoran pureblood class rule while remaining wary of DarkStar's extreme bloody massacres.

xinghai-p58.name: Dalong
xinghai-p58.brief_description: A technocrat who controls ration quotas for tens of millions of refugees in the star sector.
xinghai-p58.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A technocrat who controls ration quotas for tens of millions of refugees in the star sector.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Wearing rubber boots stained with nutrient broth, perpetually holding a withered stalk of genetically modified wheat.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Spare me your galactic politics! This batch of nutrient vats got contaminated by fungi. Ten thousand people on Juberly's outer ring will starve to death next month!"
- **Core Interests**: Protecting hydroponic bay yields and resisting malicious seed monopolies enforced by massive conglomerates.

xinghai-p59.name: Morning Star
xinghai-p59.brief_description: A divine sage of an ancient civilization residing within Feidin's sea of consciousness.
xinghai-p59.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: A divine sage of an ancient civilization residing within Feidin's sea of consciousness.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: Manifests within the mindscape as a vast halo of morning twilight, speaking with an ethereal, sweeping voice akin to a stellar symphony.
- **Tone of Voice**: "Feidin... Do not lose yourself in the aftermath of slaughter. Listen, that is the very first heartbeat of the newborn universe..."
- **Core Interests**: Shielding Feidin's soul from higher-dimensional corruption and awaiting the right moment for a full revival.

xinghai-p60.name: Psyker Prophet Phantom
xinghai-p60.brief_description: An ancient prophetic remnant from tens of thousands of years ago, etched within the altar crystals of L39.
xinghai-p60.content:
- **Identity & Movements**: An ancient prophetic remnant from tens of thousands of years ago, etched within the altar crystals of L39.
- **Appearance & Mannerisms**: A blurred, distorted humanoid of purple-gold light, accompanied at all times by the ear-piercing static of spacetime storms.
- **Tone of Voice**: "The gates of the Three Sanctuaries... shall ultimately be forced open by a black mechanical hand... Catastrophe and rebirth... spring from the very same source..."
- **Core Interests**: Imparting the final warnings of an ancient civilization to beings who set foot on the altar and pass the trial of willpower.

xinghai-a01.name: The No.47 Berth Account
xinghai-a01.brief_description: An unpaid berth bill offers work, not an automatic personal debt for everyone nearby.
xinghai-a01.content:
Berth47 owes480 Enas. Its debtor has their own responsibility; others can decline or voluntarily help with assembly or permitted salvage. Agreed work fees go to the existing port account, not into an invented loan.

The two-hour delivery window begins only when help is accepted. Scheduled outer-ring maintenance follows its own broadcast and is not canceled by payment. Falsifying the record leaves consequences for those who actually participate.

xinghai-a02.name: The Broken-Blade Wager at the Old Anchor Tavern
xinghai-a02.brief_description: The Broken-Blade Wager at the Old Anchor Tavern.
xinghai-a02.content:
- **Initial Lead**: Two drunk mercenaries from Purple Gold Armed are stomping on a young Sunil warrior's head and mocking him, while Melos lies dead drunk nearby.
- **Involved Characters**: Melos (P18), Old Anchor (P54); Location: L02.
- **Cause**: Riding their drunkenness, the mercenaries provoke the Sunil regarding their extinction crisis and smash up the bar counter.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Pay out of pocket for the Sunil warrior to compensate for the expensive spilled liquor; (2) Knock out the instigating mercenaries with precise Military-Grade Killer Punches (S13); (3) Awaken Melos sharply by invoking the disgrace of the Sunil war banner.
- **Outcome**: Earn the Sunil warrior's sworn respect; Melos begins looking at you with genuine regard.
- **Source of Rewards**: Sunil comrade's homemade bruise ointment, permission for free lodging at the tavern.

xinghai-a03.name: Scramble for the Wreckage in the Ash Basin
xinghai-a03.brief_description: Scramble for the Wreckage in the Ash Basin.
xinghai-a03.content:
- **Initial Lead**: A Sunil transport skiff fully loaded with genetic stabilizing serum crashed at the forefront of the defensive line, and mutated beast swarms are closing in.
- **Involved Characters**: Relmont (P24), Field Medic Lina (P56); Locations: L06, L07.
- **Origins & Motives**: The crashed skiff carries a three-month life-saving serum quota for the entire refuge city.
- **Approaches**: (1) Drive a tracked vehicle to force a breakthrough, deploying smoke canisters to lure away the beast swarm; (2) Infiltrate the wreckage through stealth to cut open the cockpit and rescue the critically wounded; (3) Take advantage of the chaos to embezzle a crate of serum and slip toward the black market to resell it.
- **Temporal Shifts**: The beast swarm will engulf the skiff within half an hour; stalling will lead to the serum being completely corroded by acid.
- **Outcomes**: Rescuing the serum earns the respect of all warriors in the fortress; or being branded as a thief by Relmont and hunted across the entire star system.
- **Reward Sources**: Sunil Elders' Council Medal, I09 Jaeger Mk II Exoskeleton.

xinghai-a04.name: Sanitation Order in the Godora VIP Lounge
xinghai-a04.brief_description: Sanitation Order in the Godora VIP Lounge.
xinghai-a04.content:
- **Initial Lead**: Aiselin needs a crew of untainted contract workers to purge a cargo freighter suspected of carrying a biochemical virus.
- **Involved Characters**: Aiselin (P19), Nago (P49); Location: L11, L04.
- **Cause**: Pureblood Godoran officers refuse to set foot in the filthy quarantine cargo hold, outsourcing the hazardous sanitation dirty work.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Dutifully don hazmat suits to scour the cargo hold, turning in all seized contraband in full; (2) Discover DarkStar secret ciphers deep inside the hold and secretly sell them to intelligence brokers; (3) Assist the mixed-blood pariahs aboard the vessel in fleeing into the Rust Belt.
- **Outcome**: Receive Aiselin's laborer access code, or establish contacts with the mixed-blood resistance in the Rust Belt.
- **Source of Rewards**: Official Godora bank draft (500 Enas), I52 Laborer Access Code.

xinghai-a05.name: Bloodstained Chip of the Floating Dragon Black Market
xinghai-a05.brief_description: Bloodstained Chip of the Floating Dragon Black Market.
xinghai-a05.content:
- **Initial Lead**: A critically injured assassin shoves a bloodstained chip into your chest on the stone steps, while pursuers have already sealed off the cliff.
- **Involved Characters**: Jenny (P20), Black Market Merchant; Location: L17, L19.
- **Cause**: The chip records the true money laundering ledger of the Unlimited Financial Group's loan sharks.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Shout loudly to summon Floating Dragon patrol guards, utilizing Ames's absolute ban on weapons to turn the tables on the pursuers; (2) Use the terrain to slide into the power engine room and take the risk of decrypting it; (3) Directly resell the chip to Old Anchor in the black market to get away clean.
- **Outcome**: Secure an investigation audience with Jenny, or pocket a scorching windfall of dirty money.
- **Source of Rewards**: Black market buyout cash (800 Enas), I51 Floating Dragon VIP Token.

xinghai-a06.name: Gravitational Calibration on the Abandoned Kaya Platform
xinghai-a06.brief_description: Gravitational Calibration on the Abandoned Kaya Platform.
xinghai-a06.content:
- **Initial Lead**: Volga-1 (Warwick) was cursing furiously in the Maintenance Alley, claiming that a colossal mining centrifuge on the Kaya Platform had spun out of control and was flinging entire cargo racks into open space.
- **Involved Characters**: Warwick (P26), Keran (P27); Location: L23 Kaya Abandoned Platform.
- **Origins & Motives**: Although the mining platform is abandoned, three tons of unoxidized superconducting high-energy stellar-core steel plates remain sealed inside. The runaway centrifuge prevents drones from approaching.
- **Entry Method**: Volunteer to assist Warwick in the Maintenance Alley, boarding the Grey Finch to head into the asteroid belt.
- **Approaches**: (1) Don magnetic heavy boots to sneak to the console, using Circuit Shorting and Bypassing (S02) to forcibly cut the primary power supply loop; (2) Have Warwick directly blow the distribution hub to pieces with a portable electromagnetic cannon, halting it while risking damage to the steel plates; (3) Manually calibrate the anti-gravity dampers amidst zero-gravity rotation.
- **Temporal Shifts**: Centrifugal force will completely tear apart the support bearings within eight hours, flinging all the steel plates into the gas giant's storm to be destroyed.
- **Outcomes**: Successfully shut it down and split the stellar-core steel plates (I33) evenly; or make an error that results in flying debris piercing the ship's hull.
- **Reward Sources**: Stellar-core alloy steel plates shared by Warwick, free shipping quota on the Grey Finch.
- **Subsequent Impact**: Earn the technical recognition of the three Volga brothers, unlocking collaboration on heavy firearm modifications.

xinghai-a07.name: Antibiotic Smuggling in the Rust Belt
xinghai-a07.brief_description: Antibiotic Smuggling in the Rust Belt.
xinghai-a07.content:
- **Initial Lead**: Vic quietly slipped you half a copper coin at the sewer entrance, whispering that dozens of hybrid infants in the slums were dying in large numbers from high fevers caused by fungal infections.
- **Involved Characters**: Vic (P57), Keran (P27), Godoran Peacekeepers; Locations: L13 Rust Belt, L25 Grey Finch.
- **Origins & Motives**: The Godoran homeworld health acts strictly regulate the flow of antifungal drugs into lower-tier hybrid districts, driving market prices up tenfold to exorbitant levels.
- **Entry Method**: Smuggle cheap antibiotics from the border agricultural ring via the Grey Finch, helping Vic evade the homeworld spaceport guards.
- **Approaches**: (1) Blend in aboard a regular sewage freight transport using a Stargate Fake ID Code Forgery (S25); (2) Stash the medicine into a smuggling compartment unlocked with the Secret Compartment Key (I53), using Keran's ship to drop it directly into the deep wells of the Rust Belt; (3) Report Vic to the Godoran Internal Affairs Bureau in exchange for a hefty bounty from pureblood authorities.
- **Temporal Shifts**: If no medicine arrives within three days, a severe protest riot will erupt in the hybrid district, triggering an indiscriminate bloody purge by the Peacekeepers.
- **Outcomes**: Save the hybrid civilians and become a secret brother of the resistance; or become a despised Judas and lackey reviled by all hybrid outcasts.
- **Reward Sources**: Unpolished crude energy crystals scraped together by Vic, access to the resistance underground safehouse.
- **Subsequent Impact**: Influences your reputation and standing between the Godoran faction and the hybrid faction.

xinghai-a08.name: The Sunil Veteran's Retired Greatblade
xinghai-a08.content:
- **Initial Lead**: In the Old Anchor Bar, Melos stroked the broken servo damper on his battle blade, sighing that this ancestral weapon, which had slain thirty thousand mutated beasts, was finally completely ruined.
- **Involved Characters**: Melos (P18), Black Star (P01); Locations: L02, L03.
- **Origins & Motives**: The battle blade's internal particle-focusing prism is severely worn and can no longer withstand the infusion of high-tier Pugilist Qi; it cannot be repaired without master-level machinery skills.
- **Entry Method**: Strike up a conversation when Melos is sober, offering to search far and wide for a replacement core on his behalf.
- **Approaches**: (1) Manually rewind the energy circuit coils using High-Conductivity Purple-Gold Wire (I34) brought back from Kaya and Black Star's Micro Exoskeleton Power Core Assembly Blueprint (I41); (2) Buy a used Godoran lightsaber energy condenser at an exorbitant price on the black market to cobble it together; (3) Convince Black Star to take on the repair personally while assisting him as an apprentice.
- **Temporal Shifts**: If left unattended for long, the blade will completely shatter during Melos's next drunken brawl, plunging him into irreversible, heart-dead despair.
- **Outcomes**: The battle blade re-ignites with a dazzling azure particle blade, rekindling Melos's fighting will and earning you the Broken Blade Heritage Fragment (I44).
- **Reward Sources**: Sunil Ship-Slicing Force Technique (S15) passed down privately by Melos.
- **Subsequent Impact**: Melos promises to draw his blade to aid the player once during a life-or-death crisis.

xinghai-a09.name: Silva's Old Screwdriver
xinghai-a09.content:
- **Initial Lead**: In a dark back alley on Juberly's outer ring, two collared slave traffickers are pinning a weeping, blonde-haired girl into a muddy puddle.
- **Involved Characters**: Silva (P25), Black Star (P01), Monto (P28); Location: L01, L03.
- **Cause**: Silva stole a master control chip from a trafficker's smuggling vessel while scavenging in the scrap heaps, getting caught red-handed on the spot.
- **Entry Method**: Overhear the scuffle and cries for help while passing by, or take a trash disposal chore in the back alley from Old Anchor.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Use kinetic firearms directly to shoot both slave traders dead and forcibly extract the girl; (2) Pay out of pocket to cover the chip's discounted cost and ransom Silva; (3) Lure Monto's autonomous patrol floating orb over to eliminate them under the charge of unlawful street brawling.
- **Time Progression**: If no intervention occurs within ten minutes, Silva will be injected with neuro-sedatives, crated, and shipped out of the star system to become an eternal mine slave.
- **Outcome**: Rescue Silva and escort her to Black Star's Dock No. 3; the girl will become the future Mechanics Army's most capable chief apprentice.
- **Source of Rewards**: Custom Hacker Decryption Plug (I18) gifted by Silva; increased favorability with Black Star.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Silva will be able to provide free technical assistance when you modify starships in the future.

xinghai-a10.name: Hunting the Carbonized Traces
xinghai-a10.content:
- **Initial Lead**: An urgent bulletin is posted in the Mercenary Hall: a twelve-man elite strike team from Saber stationed at the border has lost all contact, leaving behind only an empty, armored starship at the scene.
- **Involved Characters**: Ember (P17), Blood Fox (P53); Location: L30, L21.
- **Cause**: The strike team inadvertently witnessed DarkStar mothership resupply operations and was wiped out by Ember boarding alone, having their flesh instantly carbonized and evaporated.
- **Entry Method**: Accept the Saber Mercenary Corps' investigation bounty and board the derelict cruiser drifting in outer space.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Wear a Sealed Deep-Space Bio-Suit (I12) into the cabins to collect remaining black carbon residue for laboratory testing; (2) Use a decryption plug to copy the final thirty seconds of infrared surveillance footage before the bridge main computer burns out; (3) Encounter Ember's adjutant returning to tie up loose ends, detonating the corridor's high-pressure Freon fire-suppression system to cover Blood Fox's escape.
- **Time Progression**: The cruiser's scuttling protocol will activate in six hours, obliterating every trace at the scene completely.
- **Outcome**: Uncover the true culprit as the DarkStar ace "Ember," obtaining the full bounty from Saber Mercenary Corps alongside substantial prestige.
- **Source of Rewards**: A massive bounty draft of 100,000 Enas issued by the Saber Strike Battalion, Tactical Riot Helmet.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Officially placed on the high-priority watchlist of DarkStar's intelligence darknet.

xinghai-a11.name: Phantom Radio in the Iron Tomb
xinghai-a11.brief_description: Phantom Radio in the Iron Tomb.
xinghai-a11.content:
- **Initial Lead**: Old Urn pours a drink with trembling hands at the tavern, murmuring that he heard a rhythmic ancient Morse transmission coming from the decapitated battleship at the deepest floor of the Warship Graveyard.
- **Involved Characters**: Risda (P22), Old Urn (P55); Location: L38 Ancient Warship Graveyard.
- **Cause**: Risda, a super artificial intelligence from the Exploration Era ten thousand years ago, was briefly awakened after bottom-tier auxiliary power was restored and is now blindly broadcasting distress signals into deep space.
- **Entry Method**: Guided by Old Urn, take a small insulated sealed pod through the deadly floating debris storm zone.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Cut open the blast-resistant lead door of the bridge with a laser welding torch and connect the Ancient Decryption Key (I45); (2) Use Mechanical Logic Decoding (S10) to crack the three-layer defensive virus on the AI's exterior shell; (3) Forcibly pull and secure the Backup Chip (I59) before the radar sweep from the Three Universal Civilizations' archaeological patrol ships detects you.
- **Time Progression**: The close-in weapon system is intermittently recharging; every passing day doubles the number of awakened defense floating turrets.
- **Outcome**: Successfully awaken Risda and establish a mental alliance, gaining the assistance of a cosmic-tier warship master intelligence.
- **Source of Rewards**: Ancient Battleship Fire-Control Blueprint, Risda's Autonomous Core Chip.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Unlocks automated shipboard fire-control operations, but immediately draws a secret warrant from the Federation of Light's intelligence agency.

xinghai-a12.name: Precursor Reagents of the Mutation Source
xinghai-a12.brief_description: Precursor Reagents of the Mutation Source.
xinghai-a12.content:
- **Initial Lead**: An unknown malignant water mutation breaks out at a satellite water supply station outside Godora's capital, causing a sudden surge of high fevers and skeletal keratin deformities among a hundred thousand residents.
- **Involved Characters**: Anur (P16), Aiselin (P19), Theroles (P23); Location: L32, L11.
- **Cause**: DarkStar strike teams covertly dispersed the initial batch of diluted Mutation Source samples to test environmental propagation efficacy.
- **Entry Method**: Accept Aiselin's emergency external sanitation assignment, or take a contract from the resistance to investigate the truth behind the water contamination.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Use a lead-lined briefcase to forcibly sample water sediment before mutated Gluttonous Beasts breach the doors; (2) Track the poison-dispersing operative down into the sewers, neutralize him, and retrieve the Black Box containing catalytic code (I57); (3) Deliver portions of the sample to both the Godoran Academy of Sciences and Black Star's crew.
- **Time Progression**: If the main water valve is not shut down within twenty-four hours, the Godoran Cabinet will order an orbital carpet sterilization bombardment of the entire satellite colony.
- **Outcome**: Expose DarkStar's conspiracy, save hundreds of thousands of civilian lives, and become a distinguished war hero recognized by both Godora and Black Star.
- **Source of Rewards**: Godoran Royal Knight Gold Medal, 200,000 Enas military merit bounty.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Hastens strategic cooperation between Black Star and Godora, pushing the Mutation Disaster campaign into its advance preparatory phase.

xinghai-a13.name: Echoes of the Morning Star
xinghai-a13.content:
- **Initial Lead**: Near the ruins of an Astral altar in a deep-space asteroid belt, the radar communication systems of dozens of passing cargo haulers simultaneously receive an ethereal, tear-inducing melody of string music.
- **Involved Characters**: Feidin (P21), Morning Star (P59); Location: L39 Astral Altar.
- **Cause**: While meditating at the altar, Feidin inadvertently triggered a psionic resonance with "Morning Star," the high-dimensional soul within him, drawing the attention of nearby Astral Church patrol deacons.
- **Entry Method**: Follow the psychic fluctuations to land on the asteroid and escort an exhausted Feidin out of danger.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Deploy electromagnetic grenades to jam the Astral patrol skiffs' radar, maneuvering your ship to forcibly extract Feidin; (2) Intercept two fanatical high-tier Astral Monks outside the altar perimeter; (3) Channel Astral Whisper Resistance (S21) to stabilize Feidin's mind when his sea of consciousness enters turmoil.
- **Time Progression**: The psionic storm will shatter the asteroid's crust within one hour, triggering detection by the Three Universal Civilizations' dimensional surveillance grid.
- **Outcome**: Successfully rescue Feidin, earning the supreme friendship of the luckiest existence in the entire universe.
- **Source of Rewards**: String Fragment Saturated with Morning Star's Psionic Power (I58), epiphanic realization of Mind Barrier Fundamentals (S19).
- **Follow-up Impact**: Grants a chance to receive passive high-dimensional blessing and protection from Feidin's supreme luck during lethal, unavoidable dead ends in the future.

xinghai-a14.name: Guiding Shimmer of the Lightless Star
xinghai-a14.brief_description: Guiding Shimmer of the Lightless Star.
xinghai-a14.content:
- **Initial Lead**: In the orbit of a dead planet marked as "Absolute Silence" on the fringes of the Colton star chart, wandering miners claimed to have spotted a gentle white light flying on its own.
- **Involved Characters**: Aroshia, Black Star (P01); Location: L37 Lightless Star.
- **Origins & Motives**: The high-dimensional energy lifeform Aroshia has not yet fully awakened, wandering aimlessly across the pitch-black surface while absorbing faint cosmic rays.
- **Entry Method**: Equip yourself with thermal hazard gear and a blind-jump star chart, making a solo landing on the silent, blackened soil.
- **Approaches**: (1) Take two Decayed Crystal Core Shards (I36) from your backpack and hold them openly in your palm without hostility, allowing her to absorb them; (2) Attempt to establish resonance with her pure ionized force field using Micro-Gravitational Sense (S20); (3) Guide her along the correct route toward Black Star's workshop at Berth No. 3 in the Juberly Hub.
- **Temporal Shifts**: A solar storm will sweep across the planet's surface in half a day; the intense particle flux will force the cluster of light into a ten-thousand-year slumber.
- **Outcomes**: Awaken Aroshia's surface consciousness, leaving a protective shimmer imprint upon your wrist.
- **Reward Sources**: High-Dimensional Light Mark that negates a single instance of fatal energy damage, early narrative precedence in the Black Star Army core storyline.
- **Subsequent Impact**: After awakening to Beyond Grade A / Calamity-grade combat power, Aroshia will always regard the player as the first friend who showed her kindness.

xinghai-a15.name: Commercial Litigation Before the Dragon's Throne
xinghai-a15.brief_description: Commercial Litigation Before the Dragon's Throne.
xinghai-a15.content:
- **Initial Lead**: A large squad of suited bodyguards from the Financial Syndicate sealed off seven Sunil machine repair stalls in the Floating Dragon lower black market, claiming their collateral interest was five times overdue.
- **Involved Characters**: Jenny (P20), Charles (P50), Melos (P18); Location: L19 Dragon Palace.
- **Origins & Motives**: Taking advantage of the free tax haven loopholes of Floating Dragon Island, the Financial Syndicate used dual-contract schemes to aggressively swallow small and mid-sized merchants.
- **Entry Method**: Gather evidence on behalf of the victimized vendors and file a formal judicial arbitration petition to Chief Administrator Jenny.
- **Approaches**: (1) Use bureaucratic verification learned from Tripartite Civilizations Bureaucratic Maneuvering (S36) to pinpoint the fatal logical flaw in Charles's forged compounding interest, slamming it onto Jenny's desk in court; (2) Subdue the instigating syndicate bodyguards with martial force outside the hall; (3) Convince Ames to express a hint of disgust toward the syndicate's usury practices.
- **Temporal Shifts**: If valid rebuttal ledgers are not submitted within three business days, the seizure will become an irrevocable, binding ruling on Floating Dragon.
- **Outcomes**: Jenny annuls the Financial Syndicate's predatory clauses in court, heavily fining Charles and confiscating his mortgaged assets.
- **Reward Sources**: Floating Dragon Bearer VIP Token (I51) jointly gifted by the unsealed vendors, political favor from Jenny.
- **Subsequent Impact**: The Financial Syndicate's influence on Floating Dragon suffers a blow, and the player is placed on the syndicate's malicious default watch list.

xinghai-a16.name: The Volga Brothers' Explosive Formula
xinghai-a16.content:
- **Initial Lead**: An earth-shattering blast echoes from an abandoned warehouse on Juberly's outer ring; Warwick crawls out from the dense smoke, face coated in soot, yelling that the ratio was wrong again.
- **Involved Characters**: Warwick (P26), Volga Second and Third Brothers; Location: L01, L02.
- **Cause**: The three brothers accepted a massive contract to demolish a heavy pirate stronghold, but their standard blasting caps cannot scratch the ten-meter-thick alloy foundations.
- **Entry Method**: Accept Warwick's plea for help at the Old Anchor Tavern and head to the scene to provide theoretical guidance on chemistry and machinery.
- **Resolution Approaches**: (1) Draw on Advanced Energy Mechanics (S05) to propose a stepped-delay detonation scheme incorporating Concentrated High-Energy Primer (I40) and trace amounts of Freon; (2) Operate the lathe personally to grind a rheologically optimized conical shaped-charge metal liner; (3) Assist in test detonations on an uninhabited asteroid and adjust shockwave parameters.
- **Time Progression**: The pirate stronghold will complete its blast-shield upgrades in five days, rendering the quest completely expired.
- **Outcome**: Successfully develop portable shaped-charge explosives capable of cleaving cruiser keels, forging an ironclad alliance with the three Volga brothers.
- **Source of Rewards**: Three finished heavy high-energy explosive charges, assembly blueprints for an electromagnetic rapid-fire autocannon.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Enjoy a 50% discount on upfront deposits when calling the Volga brothers for demolition fire support in the future.

xinghai-a17.name: Purification Collapse of the Refuge Mother City
xinghai-a17.brief_description: Purification Collapse of the Refuge Mother City.
xinghai-a17.content:
- **Initial Intel**: The primary sirens of the Sunil Refuge Mother City scream frantically. The heavy-metal precipitation mesh of Underground Reservoir No. 3 has completely shattered, cutting off the drinking water supply for hundreds of thousands of people.
- **Involved Parties**: Relmont (P24), Combat Medic Lina (P56); Location: L08 Underground Mother City.
- **Origin & Cause**: Old-era water purification filter cores operated under severe overload for far too long, allowing acidic geothermal brine to backflow directly and corrode domestic water pipes.
- **Entry Route**: Offer your water-treatment and industrial welding skills at the fortress logistics depot to descend into the deep-water shafts alongside the emergency rescue crew.
- **Resolution Method**: (1) Don a heavy sealed biohazard suit, dive into the boiling reservoir, and weld shut the fractured main intake valve using an electric welding torch (I17); (2) Field-fabricate (S11) an emergency diversion cutoff valve using low-impurity star-core steel plates (I33); (3) Engage the reserve polymer filtration mesh and manually crank the pressurization pump to purge the acidic slurry.
- **Time Progression**: If water supply is not restored within four hours, the life-support systems of the Mother City's medical shelter will completely overload and shut down due to the loss of cooling water.
- **Outcome**: Successfully reopen the clean-water lifeline, saving critically ill veterans and young children; the entire city of Sunil fires a ceremonial artillery salute in your honor.
- **Reward Source**: Sunil's highest civilian/military honor, the Green Blood Medal personally signed by Relmont, along with permanent free food and lodging rations.
- **Follow-up Impact**: The Sunil Autonomous Army completely opens customization and procurement privileges for heavy exoskeletons in its armory to the player.

xinghai-a18.name: The Intergalactic Pirate's Black Ledger
xinghai-a18.content:
- **Initial Intel**: A grain transport barge convoy belonging to the Colton Shipping Guild along the Silver-Green Main Route was raided; the pirate leader's escape pod crashed into an asteroid belt.
- **Involved Parties**: Monto (P28), Garlan (P27); Location: L21, L22.
- **Origin & Cause**: The pirate captain holds a top-secret black ledger documenting multiple high-ranking Juberly officials colluding to plunder commercial freighters.
- **Entry Route**: Accept Captain Garlan's invitation to race ahead of the Godora patrol skiffs and scour the asteroid belt for the crashed pod.
- **Resolution Method**: (1) Breach the airlock (S28) before the wreckage catches fire, forcing the pirate to surrender bearer bonds and the data storage chip; (2) Encounter pirate hit-squad speedboats seeking to silence the crash site and precisely detonate them with anti-aircraft autocannons; (3) Tear out the sections implicating Monto to keep as blackmail material, turning the remainder over to the Shipping Guild.
- **Time Progression**: In twenty-four hours, a Godora cruiser will execute a devastating, indiscriminate orbital bombardment across the crash site.
- **Outcome**: Secure a large sum of untraceable interstellar bearer bonds while obtaining an ironclad grip over Dispatch Chief Monto.
- **Reward Source**: 50,000 Enas in cash, and a lifetime free berth amnesty granted by Monto.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Obtain unhindered smuggling transit privileges at the Juberly hub.

xinghai-a19.name: Pilgrimage Herald of the Mechanism Sect
xinghai-a19.brief_description: Pilgrimage Herald of the Mechanism Sect.
xinghai-a19.content:
- **Initial Intel**: A jet-black pilgrimage vessel from the Mechanized Empire, bearing zero signs of organic life, abruptly drops out of warp outside the Kaya Mining Station, broadcasting three mechanical logic trials across all frequencies.
- **Involved Parties**: Autonomous Herald of Manison's Domain; Location: Outskirts of L29, L23.
- **Origin & Cause**: Every decade, the Mechanized Emperor Manison deploys herald puppets across major star clusters to scout prodigies qualified to step into his mechanical realm.
- **Entry Route**: Establish a longwave data link before a mining station terminal and undergo the autonomous herald's virtual dataflow stress test.
- **Resolution Method**: (1) Hand-draw a complete topological logic diagram for antimatter containment piping with zero redundant cycles within ten minutes (S05); (2) Channel your own mechanical force into a scrap-iron gear gifted by the herald, inducing three seconds of over-frequency resonance (S12); (3) Refuse to upload your consciousness as a virtual apostle, standing firm in your convictions as a flesh-and-blood mechanic.
- **Time Progression**: The herald stays for only three days; only one candidate per star system may pass. Once time expires, the vessel automatically jumps away.
- **Outcome**: Pass all trials and obtain a high-ranking Star Sea Mechanic certification beacon acknowledged by Manison's Domain.
- **Reward Source**: Domain Titan Ancient Gear (I60), along with access decryption ciphers for a complete set of advanced machinery blueprints.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Believers of the Mechanism Sect are obligated to cross their chests and salute the player as an equal; in the future, the player can directly travel to the Central Galaxy to seek audience with Manison.

xinghai-a20.name: Recruitment Order of the Imperial Naval Base
xinghai-a20.brief_description: Recruitment Order of the Imperial Naval Base.
xinghai-a20.content:
- **Initial Intel**: The forward expeditionary force of the Crimson Empire stationed at the Colton Stargate Fortress issues an external mobilization decree: recruiting experienced independent mercenaries and specialized technicians to be inducted into the vanguard regiment of the Imperial Third Pioneer Fleet.
- **Involved Parties**: Clottey's Adjutant, Ring of the Void (P51) of Sky Ring; Location: L26 Imperial Fortress, L40 Maw of the Long Night.
- **Origin & Cause**: The three Universal Civilizations are secretly locked in an arms race to secure control over a newly discovered super stargate in the Desolate Universe Belt.
- **Entry Route**: Present a recommendation letter from a B-rank or higher mercenary group or a joint endorsement from Sunil comrades-in-arms, then report to the fortress for testing.
- **Resolution Method**: (1) Stand before the imperial military attache and endure the martial soul pressure of an adjutant serving under Beyond Grade A Dark Emperor Clottey without falling to your knees (S16); (2) Diagnose and resolve an arc-fault breakpoint hazard in the secondary battery of an Imperial heavy planet-destroyer within three minutes on-site (S02); (3) Sign an ironclad life-and-death non-disclosure military covenant dedicating your life to expanding the Empire's frontiers.
- **Time Progression**: Recruitment lasts for only ten interstellar days; once quotas are filled, the special stargate transit channel will be closed immediately.
- **Outcome**: Pass the examination, formally receive Tier-2 military clearance status with the Crimson Empire, and obtain legal military registry to march out of Colton and into the Central Galaxy.
- **Reward Source**: Crimson Empire regular army salary allowances and a special stargate transit seal.
- **Follow-up Impact**: Completely shatter the small pond limits of the Colton Star Cluster, stepping onto the grand epic stage of universal hegemony contested by the three Universal Civilizations.

xinghai-e01.name: Mutated Glutton Broodbeast — Confrontation and Choices
xinghai-e01.content:
- **Tactical Traits**: A colossal acid conglomerate the size of a moving hill, covered in heavy armored exoskeletons, spewing concentrated corrosive acid rain across the entire battlefield every two minutes.
- **Fatal Weakness**: The moment it unhinges its massive maw to spray acid, the red nerve ganglia inside its throat are left completely exposed with zero defense; heavy armor-piercing electromagnetic rounds can detonate its internal fluid sacs.
- **Evasion Plan**: Lure it into a basalt chasm and call upon Ironforged Fortress's main battery to execute carpet bombardment.
- **Loot Source**: I35 Mutated Glutton Beast Keratin Carapace, High-Energy Mutated Venom Sac.

xinghai-e02.name: DarkStar Assault Vanguard "Therol" — Confrontation and Choices
xinghai-e02.content:
- **Tactical Features**: A berserk Pugilist wielding a heavy vibrating chainsaw axe, adept at using a jetpack to execute brutal leap-chops over obstacles with sweeping, wide-open moves.

xinghai-e03.name: Carbonizing Reaper 'Ember' — Confrontation and Choices
xinghai-e03.content:

- **Fatal Weakness**: Extremely repulsed by pure metallic inorganic puppets; his Esper power corrodes heavy fully enclosed alloy mechs at an exceptionally sluggish rate.
- **Evasion Plan**: Cannot be confronted head-on. Immediately abandon all organic supplies, seal yourself behind heavy alloy blast doors, engage electromagnetic shields, and flee at full speed.

xinghai-e04.name: Floating Dragon Riot Heavy-Sword Fanatic — Confrontation and Choices

- **Fatal Weakness**: Neurological drug overload results in severe tunnel vision and an over-elevated center of gravity.
- **Evasion Plan**: Bait him into charging toward the edge of Floating Dragon Island's precipice, tripping him into the void at the gravity fracture zone.
- **Loot Source**: Large-caliber kinetic firearm parts, heavy lead-lined wallet.

xinghai-e05.name: Iron Grave Autonomous Mechanical Defense System 'Pioneer Core' — Confrontation and Choices

xinghai-d01.name: Acid-Rain Exhaust in the Maintenance Shaft
xinghai-d01.brief_description: Acid-Rain Exhaust in the Maintenance Shaft.
xinghai-d01.content:
Thick condensation coats the inside of your gas mask, turning into icy droplets with each breath that slide down your collar. The high-pressure exhaust valve overhead groans like a dying behemoth, spewing a pungent plume of mixed Freon and engine oil exhaust that blows the sparks from your laser torch all over the place.
Monto's rusty floating collection drone hovers less than half a meter behind the back of your head, its speaker blaring in a monotonous mechanical drone: "Berthing arrears: four hundred eighty Enar. Countdown: thirty-four minutes."
The wrench is jammed tight against a stripped brass nut. The internal pipe heat sears through your asbestos gloves, biting painfully into your palm. You can either force the valve back into place right now at the cost of scorching your hands, or scramble down the ladder to borrow an extended torque sleeve from the young man in the black duster wiring up a ship next door.
- **Possible Outcomes**: Make the acquaintance of Black Star (P01) directly; trigger affair A01; or suffer burns from the exhaust fumes and be forced to visit the medical station.

xinghai-d02.name: The Mixed Gamble at the Old Anchor Bar
xinghai-d02.brief_description: The Mixed Gamble at the Old Anchor Bar.
xinghai-d02.content:
The air here is thick enough to spoon, and holographic tubes bathe the counter in a sickly green glow. Three four-armed purple-gold miners slam bloodstained minted coins down onto a rusty reactor heat shield, bellowing crude insults in Galactic Common aimed at each other's home planets.
Melos slumps in the darkest corner booth against the wall, a beat-up folding greatsword taller than a man laid under the table. Two straps on his second-hand battle armor are snapped. He tilts his head back, guzzling half a bottle of cheap, diesel-tinged industrial alcohol, hacking violently until his eyes turn red.
Behind the counter, the old barkeep wipes glasses with a greasy rag, saying without even looking up: "Fresh meat, don't stare at the drunk. Last month some fool mercenary tried to cop a feel of his blade; the guy's still frozen stiff in the outer-ring trash bin. You want synthetic ale for three Enar a glass, or two tubes of near-expired painkiller paste?"
- **Possible Outcomes**: Advance affair A02's gambling negotiation; probe the Old Anchor for black-market munitions base prices; examine the structure of Melos's blade.

xinghai-d03.name: Welding Sparks and Fire-Rain in the Drydock
xinghai-d03.brief_description: Welding Sparks and Fire-Rain in the Drydock.
xinghai-d03.content:
A gravity-screening barrier seals out the absolute void beyond, trapping sweltering heat within the gargantuan No. 3 Drydock. Four industrial mechanical arms suspended from a hundred-meter rail slice into the flank armor of a medium armed frigate with a deafening roar, splashing molten iron that bursts into a blizzard of white sparks.
Black Star crouches beneath the exposed chassis, black duster sleeves rolled up to his elbows, smudges of soot smeared across his face. He grips a high-frequency electric torch, biting down on a miniature level.
He nudges the heavy energy-storage capacitors scattered beside him with his boot, barking without looking up: "Don't just stand there inhaling iron filings! Pass me the No. 3 high-conduction purple-gold wire from that crate over there, and keep the power valve's needle pinned two ticks below the redline. Let the pressure spike and short the circuit, and I'll shove you into a torpedo tube and fire you as a decoy."
- **Possible Outcomes**: Assist Black Star in refitting the assault ship; learn prerequisite techniques for S04 or S08; obtain blueprint clues for I41.

xinghai-d04.name: Pre-Battle Prayers at the Iron Fortress
xinghai-d04.brief_description: Pre-Battle Prayers at the Iron Fortress.
xinghai-d04.content:
A biting, blood-reeking wind sweeps up from the Ash Basin and over the ramparts, carrying the stench of crusted beast blood. Every ten seconds, the heavy electromagnetic CIWS barrels hum in a low self-test cycle while treaded armored vehicles rumble on diesel power.
Dozens of Sunil warriors gather around the ammo crates, grimly latching the buckles of their exoskeleton breastplates shut. Chieftain Relmont drives his notched ancestral blade deep into a basalt fissure, retrieving a bullet-riddled clan banner from his chest to drape across the hilt.
There are no rousing speeches. In the logistics barracks corridor, a few one-armed veterans press stone-hard biscuits of compressed dough into the hands of young warriors, murmuring softly: "Chew it well, get it down. The kids in the city got half a tube of clean water today; they're all watching us from the bunker entrances."
- **Possible Outcomes**: Join the fortress defensive perimeter watch; requisition the I09 Sunil Type-II Exoskeleton; trigger the A03 wreckage search-and-rescue mission.

xinghai-d05.name: Pureblood Quarantine at the Welcome Spire
xinghai-d05.brief_description: Pureblood Quarantine at the Welcome Spire.
xinghai-d05.content:
Harsh ultraviolet sterilization beams sweep over you from head to toe three full times. A potent disinfectant spray blasts your face with the stinging smell of antiseptic, bringing tears to your eyes.
Behind two layers of bulletproof, germ-resistant vacuum glass, Aeslyn sits poised on a levitating, high-backed velvet chair. Her blonde hair is pulled back into an exquisite net, and an immaculate, gold-trimmed white officer's dress uniform accentuates her arrogant posture. She taps on a holopad with a white silk-gloved forefinger, unwilling to spare you a direct glance.
The guard droid beside her scans your temporary labor wristband with a harsh green flash. Aeslyn frowns, instructing in a crisp, chillingly indifferent voice: "Tag his pass with Grade-C quarantine status. Inform the port authority that this batch of day-laborers from secondary civilizations may only use Sanitation Duct 38 to enter the hold. If I catch a single germ-carrier wandering into the Third Council Chamber, the entire skyport riot guard will be scrubbing decks for three months."
- **Possible Outcomes**: Accept the A04 hold decontamination order; contact the Godora mixed-blood resistance underground; obtain the I52 labor code.

xinghai-d06.name: Smuggling Rendezvous on the Floating Dragon Precipice
xinghai-d06.brief_description: Smuggling Rendezvous on the Floating Dragon Precipice.
xinghai-d06.content:
Below your boots lies a bottomless abyss with no railing. The violent artificial gravity field along the asteroid's outer rim whips your mantle into a frenzy, sending loose gravel tumbling down the steep blackstone steps to vanish instantly into the freezing, deep sea of stars.
Draped in a heavy anti-radiation cloak, the black-market dealer hunches halfway inside a recessed cave in the cliff. Wasting no words, he flicks open the corner of your canvas satchel with the muzzle of a large-caliber blaster pistol, revealing rows of neatly slotted energy-crystal canisters.
"Purity looks right." The dealer's voice grates like sandpaper against iron. He slides a hefty lead-plated briefcase out of the shadows. "Here are three Floating Dragon neutrality transit passes privately approved by Overseer Jenny, plus two crates of armor-piercing high-explosive rounds with intact serials. Count them up. Floating Dragon doesn't do after-sales. If you get jumped by the guards right outside this cave, Lady Ames won't shed a single tear for you."
- **Possible Outcomes**: Conclude the transfer of supplies in A05 or A07; acquire the I51 Floating Dragon VIP Pass; get entangled in an assassination tail.

xinghai-d07.name: Engineless Drifting in the Asteroid Belt
xinghai-d07.brief_description: Engineless Drifting in the Asteroid Belt.
xinghai-d07.content:
To evade the active phased array radars of two Godora cruisers, the "Grey Finch" completely pulled the breaker on its nuclear fusion reactor, even coldly severing the most basic heating conduits.
The cargo hold was as frigid as a morgue, every breath frosting over the faceplate into a thin layer of ice. Wrapped in an oil-stained fur blanket, Captain Galan curled up entirely in the copilot seat, hands gripping a chambered kinetic pistol tightly, his eyes gleaming in the dark like those of a dying wolf.
Outside the viewport, several massive black asteroids swept past silently a hundred meters away, and farther out stretched an azure hyperdrive jump band spanning the sky. Muffled "thud-thud" sounds of debris collisions occasionally reverberated through the hull, every impact sending hearts pounding in terror, dreading that a breached airlock would bleed away the last remaining air.
- **Potential Trajectories**: Learn S34 Blind Jump Obstacle Avoidance; repair I04 Portable Kinetic Belt-Fed Submachine Cannon in the freezing, dead silence; deepen life-and-death trust with Galan.

xinghai-d08.name: Bedside Visit in the Sanctuary Metropolis
xinghai-d08.brief_description: Bedside Visit in the Sanctuary Metropolis.
xinghai-d08.content:
Three hundred meters beneath the surface, the sanctuary city reeks of fermenting mold and sulfur steam. Ventilation fans groan heavily, and geothermal water weeping from the walls collects into murky rivulets on the concrete floor.
Cots pack both sides of the shelter's long corridor, bearing severely wounded soldiers writhing in agony. Sweat drenches the field surgeon's forehead as her pneumatic bone saw whines in a high-pitched screech, severing a section of exoskeleton prosthesis blackened and necrotic from acid burns; the smell of singed flesh turns the stomach.
A Sunil girl of barely seven or eight stands barefoot by the bed, clinging tightly to her father's cold, lifeless mechanical fingers. Her wide eyes hold no tears, only a precocious numbness. Driving the last needle of diluted antibiotics home, the doctor grates through clenched teeth: "Those Godoran leeches... slashed our medical quota in half again. Without stabilizers, this defense line caves by tomorrow."
- **Possible Outcomes**: Accept mission A17 Clean Water Emergency Repairs; return the I50 Fallen Soldier Dog Tag; trigger long-term quest Q02 Save the Sunils.

xinghai-d09.name: Number Calling and Job Scramble in the Mercenary Hall
xinghai-d09.brief_description: Number Calling and Job Scramble in the Mercenary Hall.
xinghai-d09.content:
The three-story-tall holographic screen at the center of the hall abruptly shifts from cool blue to glaring scarlet. Accompanied by piercing siren buzzes, a bold line of blood-red text detonates above the heads of hundreds of thousands of alien mercenaries: "Colton Westwind Route Grade-S Escort Contract, bounty 700,000 Enar, casualty pensions fully underwritten by Purple-Gold Heavy Industries!"
The cacophonous hall drops dead silent, then erupts into an earth-shattering wave of shoving and curses.
Several three-meter-tall heavy Pugilists batter down the marble barricades with armored shoulders, bellowing as they wave mercenary cards and charge the terminal consoles. Behind the windows, the synthetic tellers can barely grab their stamps before the metal riot grates warp violently under the frantic crush. In a quiet corner, two Saber Mercenary Corps assassins slip their vibro-daggers from their sheaths, their gazes locking onto the spine of the rival in front who is about to hit the confirm key.
- **Possible Outcomes**: Compete for high-tier escort contracts; learn S30 Black Market Jargon; build mercenary crew prestige.

xinghai-d10.name: Vacuum Scavenging in the Warship Ruins
xinghai-d10.brief_description: Vacuum Scavenging in the Warship Ruins.
xinghai-d10.content:
The jetpack's fuel light has been blinking red for ten minutes amid an endless sea of steel wreckage. An ancient ten-thousand-year-old battleship broken into three sections looms before you, its twisted, torn keel resembling the stark ribs of a giant beast.
Clamped tight to the cratered exterior of the bridge via mag-boots, you run a high-frequency plasma torch to slowly carve through the command room's armored blast door. In the absolute vacuum, glowing golden slag drifts away as countless perfectly round droplets of cooled metal.
Through the narrow slit, faint green indicators flicker intermittently deep within the command bridge. Risda's backup main brain matrix slumbers there in silence, while hundreds of meters behind you, tucked behind a drifting armor plate, a reawakened, rogue autonomous CIWS drone slowly rotates its phased-array radar, its barrels humming with crackling blue arcs of charging power.
- **Possible Outcomes**: Trigger E05 Formidable Foe Encounter; fulfill affair A11 to awaken Risda (P22); obtain the I59 Core Chip.

xinghai-d11.name: Looking Up Before the Dragon Palace
xinghai-d11.brief_description: Looking Up Before the Dragon Palace.
xinghai-d11.content:
Paved in deep obsidian, the floor gleams like a mirror, reflecting the deep and distant starry skies above. Devoid of load-bearing pillars, the hall stretches vast and empty, compelling visitors to hold their breath as footsteps kick up hollow echoes beneath the hundred-meter dome.
Ames reclines across the distant Void Throne, one hand cradling her chin, her silken black hair cascading across the floor. She does not even turn to look at you, merely flipping a page in the ancient paper tome she holds.
With that single, subtle motion, an indescribably crushing force field descends from on high. The air seems to solidify into lead in an instant; your kneecaps emit faint, strained creaks, and the rotational gravity of the entire Floating Dragon island feels pliable beneath her breath, molded at her whim. Standing at the foot of the dais, Chancellor Jenny adjusts her glasses, reading the assessment in an icy voice: "Your vessel wiped out three outer raiding pirate bands. Lady Ames permits you three months of tax-free residence in the lower tier. Begone, and do not disturb her peace."
- **Possible Outcomes**: Face the absolute supreme might of Beyond Grade A Ames; unlock legitimate legal refugee status on Floating Dragon; advance the Q03 storyline.

xinghai-d12.name: Leaping Through the Throat of the Long Night
xinghai-d12.brief_description: Leaping Through the Throat of the Long Night.
xinghai-d12.content:
The stargate's ten-thousand-meter stabilization anchors streak backward outside the viewport. Two dazzling azure plasma containment rings spin wildly at the edges of your vision, wrenching the spacetime curvature ahead into a massive, deep-blue singularity vortex.
The freighter's frame groans in shrill, agonizing metallic strain beneath the terrifying spacetime tides. Gravitational g-forces press you hard into the coarse anti-G seat, squeezing nearly every breath from your lungs. With trembling hands, you twist open a flask and swallow a mouthful of machine-oil-scented water; the freezing fluid burns down your throat, triggering a violent shudder.
The next second, the artificial singularity detonates, and countless hyperspace streamers thoroughly engulf your retinas. The clamor of the Colton Star Cluster, the blood-soaked feud between Godora and DarkStar, and the cramped, damp decompression corridors of Juberly Hub vanish behind you in a heartbeat. Before you lies an endless sea of stars, where the roaring engines hurl you headlong into your true interstellar journey.
- **Possible Outcomes**: Complete the ultimate closure of the Colton Chapter; formally step forward into the wider Shattered Star Ring and the Central Galaxy.

xinghai-r01.name: Garton Faction · Juberly Hub
xinghai-r01.content:
Places in this region include Juberly Outer Ring Decompression Corridor No. 47, Old Anchor Machine Bar and Secondhand Ship Material Bazaar, Hub No. 3 Vacuum Refit Drydock, Interstellar Mercenary Guild Juberly Office, Blind End of Abandoned Waste Decompression Well No. 47. Work, news and relationships develop with events in each place.

## Life and paths through the region

The outer ring survives on ventilation, power and casual work; inner docks depend on completed repairs; the mercenary office verifies people and scopes jobs. Settling one invoice does only that. Assembly, licensed recovery and forged records leave different evidence. A mechanic can start by preserving equipment, obtaining tools and completing one real assembly. Leaving by a lawful passenger or cargo service does not require owning a warship.

xinghai-r02.name: Sunil Homeworld · Catastrophe Wasteland and Frontline Fortress
xinghai-r02.brief_description: Sunil Homeworld · Catastrophe Wasteland and Frontline Fortress.
xinghai-r02.content:
Places in this region include Iron Fortress First Defensive Line, Ashen Basin Outer Containment Dead Line, Sunil Underground Refugee Mother City, Genetic Decay Terminal Shelter, Rift Covert Observation Outpost. Work, news and relationships develop with events in each place.

## Life and paths through the region

The front, quarantine line, underground city and hospice need different help. Repaired carriers reduce exposure; supply escorts need a viable route and willing personnel; medicine and samples need informed recipients. A volunteer can take one delivery or inspection without promising to save an entire people.

If an observation post reports the same creature call repeatedly, compare timestamps, wind and retained recordings. An old rebroadcast is not a new assault. Fresh physical evidence may change that conclusion. Losses and departures remain real; one victory does not establish an eternal dawn.

xinghai-r03.name: Godora Civilization · Homeworld and Ring-Orbit City
xinghai-r03.brief_description: Godora Civilization · Homeworld and Ring-Orbit City.
xinghai-r03.content:
Places in this region include Holy Gold Skyport Welcome Space Station, Sunflower Parliament Avenue, Sunken Half-Blood Slums 'Rust Belt', Royal Academy of Life Sciences Genetics Institute, DarkStar Surface Infiltration Secret Nest. Work, news and relationships develop with events in each place.

## Life and paths through the region

Port labor, parliamentary offices and the genetics institute have separate reception boundaries. Rustbelt residents need usable supplies and fair treatment, but are not one organization. Introducing a coworker does not guarantee a whole neighborhood. Language, repairs and freight work can build contacts; a temporary permit opens no universal laboratory door.

Mislabelled returned cargo can be checked against manifests, handlers and the receiving instruments. A transport mismatch may be corrected directly. Discrimination or deliberate obstruction requires its own evidence, not an inference from ancestry.

xinghai-r04.name: Neutral Holy Ground · Floating Dragon Island
xinghai-r04.brief_description: Neutral Holy Ground · Floating Dragon Island.
xinghai-r04.content:
Places in this region include Floating Island Skyport Suspended Flight Deck, Cliffside Rock Wall Black Market Corridor, Floating Dragon Lower Cavern Bar, Palace of the Dragon Main Council Hall, Floating Island Engine Core and Shield Hub. Work, news and relationships develop with events in each place.

## Life and paths through the region

Berths, cliff markets and lower taverns have different owners and customs. The Dragon Palace is not a walk-in office. Climbing, repairs, trade and hired escorts offer separate livelihoods; one delivered job matters more than claiming acquaintance with a great power.

A ship name ground off a component does not alone prove theft. A replaced casing, lawful scrapping or deliberate concealment are different possibilities. Wear, seller records and public registration can answer this component's provenance. Buy, return, repair or leave after checking; a market visit need not recruit anyone into a mercenary outfit.

xinghai-r05.name: Colton Star Cluster Fringe · Shipping Chokepoints and Pirate Lanes
xinghai-r05.brief_description: Colton Star Cluster Fringe · Shipping Chokepoints and Pirate Lanes.
xinghai-r05.content:
Places in this region include Silver-Green Main Shipping Lane Zephyr Jump Point, Rubble Belt Exile Resupply Outpost, Abandoned Kaya Deep-Space Mining Platform, Chaida Soilless Agricultural Biosphere Ring, The Gray Finch Modified Armed Freighter. Work, news and relationships develop with events in each place.

## Life and paths through the region

Westwind is a transit point, the rubble outpost refuels travelers, Kaya retains industrial problems and the agriculture ring still depends on harvests. Navigation can check a beacon, electrical repair can preserve a pump, and negotiation can secure one bounded shipment. Without piloting capacity or fuel, seek a carrier; hearing coordinates is not arriving.

The outpost receives regular distress pulses with timestamps moving backward. Synchronized measurements and the original relay record distinguish clock drift, replay and a live caller. Once answered, preserve the public beacon or recover authorized components. Not every signal leads to an ancient fleet.

xinghai-r06.name: The Three Universal Civilizations and the Central Galaxy Border
xinghai-r06.brief_description: The Three Universal Civilizations and the Central Galaxy Border.
xinghai-r06.content:
Places in this region include Crimson Empire Expeditionary Vanguard Stargate Fortress, Radiant Federation Pantheon Star Cluster Peripheral Office, Void Temple Deep-Space Prayer Sanctuary, Mechanized Empire, Limitless Financial Group Pan-Cosmic Logistics & Financial Relay Hub. Work, news and relationships develop with events in each place.

## Life and paths through the region

The gate fortress prioritizes routes and supplies, the federation office identity and visit scope, and the sanctuary ritual and restricted areas. Being a mechanic does not grant access to the Mechanical Nation's equipment. A logistics relay can trace one consignment, not expose the universe's finances.

Reaching these places is a distant possibility built on transport, skill and credible introductions, not an early checklist. Permission covers its agreed place, purpose and period. A refusal leaves public ports, learning, trade and alternate routes available. One job need not decide a lifetime allegiance among civilizations.

xinghai-r07.name: DarkStar Deep Space Shadow Fleet
xinghai-r07.content:
Places in this region include DarkStar Galaxy-Class Stealth Mothership 'The Matrix' Command Bridge, Mutagen Progenitor Incubation Reactor Chamber, Carbonization Hunt Training Ground, Pureblood Deprivation Confession Room, Deep-Space Phantom Torpedo Tube Array. ## Life and paths through the region

The hidden fleet's position, internal compartments and command privileges are not public geography. Reconnaissance, recovered records or a credible contact can establish limited, dated information. An authored place name does not admit a stranger to a bridge.

Intercepted code may be isolated, compared with a source or entrusted to a capable analyst rather than immediately used to destroy a mothership. Escorting one escapee, preserving testimony or withdrawing from a lost post can be complete actions. Later evidence may overturn an interpretation; correct it while retaining real costs of the earlier error instead of substituting another villain.

xinghai-r08.name: Desolate Cosmos Belt and Ancient Ruins
xinghai-r08.brief_description: Desolate Cosmos Belt and Ancient Ruins.
xinghai-r08.content:
