Work, news and relationships develop with events in each place.

## Life and paths through the region

Scarcity at a ruin begins with a verified route, equipment endurance and return reserves. The black-hole observatory, Lightless World and Iron Tomb are not adjacent corridors; each requires an actual arrival. Survey an edge, repair one relay or preserve a record before accepting deeper risk.

An apparently responsive broadcast may be conscious contact or a preserved question-and-answer program. Timestamps, behavior after a power interruption and independent sensors can distinguish them. Do not announce revived machine life before verification. A solved mystery may be returned, sealed or left behind; a valuable discovery need not become the key to a universal war.

xinghai-w01.name: Galaxy Calendar 689: The World and the Era
xinghai-w01.brief_description: Galaxy Calendar 689: The World and the Era.
xinghai-w01.content:
## Chapter 1: World Structure and the Cosmic Ladder

### 1.1 Era Background: Galaxy Calendar 689
This was the eve of a tempest poised to sweep through multiple civilizations across the Colton Star Cluster.
On Planet Aquamarine, the Germinal Organization had already been reduced to historical ruins amidst the fires of war, and the six continental nations were busy carving up territories on the scorched earth. Yet in the vast sea of stars, this remote backwater planet had failed to attract the notice of even a single cruiser belonging to advanced civilizations.
In the Colton Star Cluster, the glittering golden radiance of the Godora Civilization could not conceal the bloody exploitation their pureblood ruling class had inflicted upon lower-tier mixed-bloods for centuries; the extremist mixed-blood organization "DarkStar" was secretly plotting to trigger the "Mutation Disaster" across multiple star systems; the Sunil people were bleeding their very last drops of life on their homeworld against brutal periodic beast tides; and star-cluster-grade mercenary corps were greedily dividing lucrative bounty contracts amid ceaseless border skirmishes.
This was a cruel universe devoid of chosen saviors and immortal freaks. In the eyes of interstellar superpowers, indigenous beings from low-energy secondary civilizations did not even qualify as slaves. Only the sharpest calculations, the steeliest nerves, and the most hardcore craftsmanship could secure a fighting chance of survival beneath the grinding gears of the cosmos.

### 1.2 The Cosmic Power Pyramid: The Three Universal Civilizations and the Beyond Grade A Myth
The known universe was firmly dominated by three Universal Civilizations:
1. **Crimson Empire**: An iron-blooded juggernaut dominating the Central Galaxy, possessing the universe's largest regular standing fleet and Pugilist vanguard legions, dedicated to absolute military hegemony.
2. **Federation of Light**: An ancient, arrogant titan of capital and technology, controlling star gate patent networks and industrial motherbeds, adept at dismembering dissenters through financial manipulation and proxy warfare.
3. **Arcane Church**: A theocratic empire of high-dimensional faith, monopolizing the void dimensions and prophetic altars, fanatically pursuing spiritual ascension.

Beneath the feet of the Three Universal Civilizations lay various star-cluster-grade regimes, countless star-system-grade civilizations, and exiled factions.
Yet the universe's true ultimate deterrent were the **Beyond Grade A** powerhouses who stood above interstellar fleets—every one of them was a walking strategic nuclear warhead. Resisting planetary-obliteration cannons with raw flesh and annihilating fleets single-handedly were not exaggerated legends in their hands, but bloody, practical reality.

### 1.3 Core Stage Slice: Colton Star Cluster and Juberly Hub
This scenario begins anchored at the core crossroads of the **Shattered Star Ring · Colton Star Cluster · Garton Star System**—the **Juberly Hub**.
There were no laws here, only the trade regulations of the Mercenary League and rent collection notices from the hub administration. Interstellar pirates, down-and-out mechanics, desperate Pugilists, and refugees from secondary civilizations converged at this nexus. Meanwhile, a young mechanic named Han Xiao (Black Star), who had just carved his way off Planet Aquamarine through meticulous calculations and cold-blooded maneuvers, was leading a rudimentary refitted squad into Docking Bay 3, quietly unveiling his prelude to stirring the universe's storm.

---

xinghai-c01.name: Indebted Conduit Sweeper
xinghai-c01.content:
- **Background Summary**: You escaped that backward home planet aboard a smuggled mining ship, barely scraping together a living on the outer ring of Juberly Hub by repairing high-pressure exhaust pipes and derelict circuits. Your craft is rough but sturdy enough; a chunk of flesh was burned off your left index finger by a high-energy laser during a welding accident.
- **Starting Location**: L01 Juberly Outer Ring Decompression Corridor No. 47.
- **Initial Relationships**: Owe Dispatcher Monto (P28) two months of berth management fees; acquainted with the bartender at the L02 bar, who warned you that the account must be cleared tonight.
- **Reasonable Starting Inventory**: A heavily worn portable laser welding torch (I17), half a tube of gel hemostatic ointment, an overdue berthing magnetic card (I49), three tubes of near-expiry surrogate nutrient paste.
- **Initial Crisis**: Monto's hovering debt-collection drone has already stationed itself outside your container door flashing red lights, with less than two hours remaining before the outer ring airlock conducts its "routine vacuum sweep."

xinghai-c02.name: Sunil Frontline Corpse Collector
xinghai-c02.content:
- **Background Summary**: Displaced by wartime turmoil on your home planet, you were hired by the Sunil as a frontline logistics auxiliary. Your primary duty is to pry usable power chips from acid-corroded exoskeleton wrecks and gather the dog tags of fallen warriors to bring back to the city.
- **Starting Location**: L06 Ironclad Fortress Logistics Barracks.
- **Initial Relationships**: Under the jurisdiction of Sunil Guard Commander Relmont (P24); owe a favor to the field medic for a high-concentration anti-infection injection.
- **Reasonable Starting Inventory**: A set of slightly scratched second-hand Type-II exoskeleton leg braces, an alloy prybar, a heavy lead-lined anti-radiation body bag, three Sunil fallen dog tags (I50).
- **Initial Crisis**: Forward scouts have sent back an alert: a minor assault by mutated beasts has breached Auxiliary Gate No. 3, and the outfitting tunnel you occupy is currently blocked by two stray acid burrowing beasts.

xinghai-c03.name: Floating Dragon Black Market Runner Apprentice
xinghai-c03.brief_description: Floating Dragon Black Market Runner Apprentice.
xinghai-c03.content:
- **Background Overview**: You work as an errand runner for various peddlers in the steep cliff-face black market of the Floating Dragon island. You know which vendor adulterates their raw energy stones, and you know which rock fissures allow you to slip past guard patrols.
- **Starting Location**: L17 Cliffside Black Market Corridor.
- **Initial Relationships**: Bossed around by the black market bookkeeper; once handed a sobriety mint potion to a drunken mercenary at the L18 bar, overhearing half of a smuggling passphrase.
- **Reasonable Starting Inventory**: A pair of windproof cliff-climbing gloves, a parchment star chart scribbled with secret passages, half a bottle of cheap sobriety menthol liquid, a small pouch of unpolished low-purity energy crystal chips.
- **Initial Crisis**: A mortally wounded assassin shoved a blood-stained data chip into your trouser pocket right before drawing his last breath, and two cloaked pursuers are slowly closing in along the cliffside stone stairs.

xinghai-w03.name: A Parallel Star Ocean
xinghai-w03.content: This parallel fan-fiction world opens in Starsea Year 689. The Black Star Mercenary Group is still young. Offices, relationships and living presence follow the period-specific profiles and facts already established in this Story, without predetermining later allegiances, achievements or endings. Distant people require real travel, introductions or formal communication. A historical-only entry is not a living person waiting to appear. The protagonist does not inherit Black Star's identity or turn an outlook into completed history.

xinghai-radio.name: Portable Full-Band Radio
xinghai-radio.brief_description: A refurbished portable transceiver for voice and response codes on agreed channels. Distance and network conditions still affect the signal.
xinghai-radio.content:
A refurbished civilian full-band transceiver with a manual tuning dial and a short-range aerial. Tune to a public band to hear passing broadcasts. To speak with someone willing to stay in touch, exchange call signs, agree on a channel and try the link for voice or response codes.

Communication-equipment stalls at Old Anchor’s secondhand ship-material bazaar, the Sunil underground city, Floating Dragon’s cliffside black market and the rubble-belt supply outpost stock it for a firm 120 Enars, cash only.

The box contains a radio, not an address book. Private channels, network permits and secret codes still have to come from the people concerned; interstellar calls also depend on an available network along the way. In a shielded zone, an outage or beyond coverage, the speaker gives only static until contact can be restored.

It can transmit and receive, but lacks the listening and decryption power of a vehicle-mounted high-power signal processor. Encrypted dead letters and quantum-secured traffic do not become readable just because this radio is in your hand.

xinghai-signal-processor.name: Carrier-Mounted High-Power Signal Processor
xinghai-signal-processor.brief_description: A guild listening rig on a small service carrier; operating it requires dead-letter decryption training.
xinghai-signal-processor.content:
The shipping guild mounts an antenna array, signal processor and power supply on a short-range service carrier so crews can find a quiet listening position along the docks. The guild counter at Westwind Jump Point sells the complete rig for 1,200 Enar. Its operator must know Dead-Letter Decryption on Sealed Frequencies.

This is unarmed working equipment, not a combat vehicle. Four hours of listening and ten units of carrier fuel can recover a few broken phrases from an ordinary mercenary or smuggler hopping-frequency recording. Quantum-entangled secure traffic remains unreadable.

A recovered phrase does not identify a caller or open a private channel. Names, access and the reliability of the message still need other evidence.

xinghai-hopping-recording.name: Ordinary Hopping-Traffic Recording
xinghai-hopping-recording.brief_description: An ordinary hopping-frequency recording, full of hiss, crossed signals and clipped voices.
xinghai-hopping-recording.content:
The guild counter at Westwind Jump Point sells unverified ordinary hopping-traffic recordings for 60 Enar each. These tapes contain conventional electromagnetic traffic, not data from quantum-entangled secure links.

A trained dead-letter analyst can work through a tape on a carrier-mounted high-power processor. Four hours of processing uses up the working recording and leaves a few intelligible fragments; the missing passages do not become complete intelligence.

xinghai-signal-fragments.name: Recovered Hopping-Traffic Fragments
xinghai-signal-fragments.brief_description: A handful of phrases recovered from ordinary hopping traffic; the sender is still unconfirmed.
xinghai-signal-fragments.content:
“Supplies … shift change … old berth.” Long stretches of noise separate the words, and the timestamps have gaps. This is the residue of four hours of signal analysis, not a complete plaintext, a caller identity or permission to use a channel.

The fragments may help corroborate something learned elsewhere. Alone they establish neither who spoke nor where an arrangement was made. The guild does not buy back these unverified notes.

xinghai-sparring.name: Training Target Machine
xinghai-sparring.brief_description: A low-power laser rig beside the Drydock No. 3 workbenches for checking protective gear.
xinghai-sparring.content:
A current-limited laser rig stands beside the drydock workbenches. Mechanics use it to test protective gear and evasive movements. Its low-power beam can still burn unprotected skin.

Once running, the beam repeatedly sweeps its marked test area. Stopping the rig means getting clear of the beam and reaching the control switch. Veteran mechanics warn apprentices never to step into its path with bare hands, however harmless the rating may look.

xinghai-electronic-node.name: Exposed Iron Tomb aiming node
xinghai-electronic-node.brief_description: An old aiming instrument still tracks intruders, eight metres beyond the hatch.
xinghai-electronic-node.content: A damaged close-defence circuit still glows in the wreck field. Its barrel follows shadows beyond the hatch. The instrument casing has fallen away, leaving its lines exposed on a bracket eight metres out. A near-field arc can interrupt one reply, and ordinary tools can damage this vulnerable node. Breaking it does not defeat the distant Pioneer Mind.

xinghai-life-identity.name: Three backgrounds, an open course
xinghai-life-identity.brief_description: Clearance workers, Sunil auxiliaries and Floating Dragon runners have different social worlds and are equally valid protagonists.
xinghai-life-identity.content:
Clearance workers, Sunil auxiliaries and Floating Dragon runners have different social worlds and are equally valid protagonists. Arrears belong to the actual debtor; gratitude for medicine is not a cash loan; a bloodied chip becomes someone’s concern only after delivery. The three opening pressures do not accumulate on every character.

Repair work, escort, learning and seeking a future for one’s homeland are possible, as are refusing work, changing employers and caring for companions. The Starforging Hammer, Breaking the Cocoon and Weaving Shadows are interests, not three mandatory destinations. A delivery, rescue or temporary team establishes only what happened. Life does not require a state, an army or every secret solved.

xinghai-life-work.name: Skills, employment and access
xinghai-life-work.brief_description: Dock waiting areas, repair bays, port counters, palaces and military cores are separate thresholds.
xinghai-life-work.content:
Dock waiting areas, repair bays, port counters, palaces and military cores are separate thresholds. Knowing someone, paying a fee or carrying expensive equipment does not replace permission and competence. Understanding a repair explanation is not mastering a blueprint; watching surgery is not learning it. Machines need energy, parts and suitable conditions and retain wear. An impressive weapon name does not bridge the scale from a person to a ship or celestial body.

Employers explain work, recipient and payment before someone accepts. Accepted work carries agreed reporting and handover; without consent there is no automatic employment. Goods have owners and credit has actual terms. An organisation’s wealth is not player inventory. Repairs, purchases and study may begin as enquiries; an unfulfilled plan does not make a ship new, a wound healed or payment received.

xinghai-life-news.name: Interstellar news and nearby people
xinghai-life-news.brief_description: Public vacancies, reports received at the mercenary hall, bar rumours, private communications and author-known secrets are distinct sources.
xinghai-life-news.content:
Public vacancies, reports received at the mercenary hall, bar rumours, private communications and author-known secrets are distinct sources. Radio reception depends on equipment, band and actual content. A fragment is not complete coordinates; reaching a person does not place them nearby or secure their company. Ordinary talk is not mystical communication, and sharing a ship does not share all messages.

Travel, maintenance, rest and agreed deadlines take time. Unaccepted work does not become overdue. Distant factions pursue their affairs; the player receives sourced news, not omniscient battle plans or future rosters. Helping a technician, patient or trader can earn specific trust and later contact, not immediate group loyalty, national friendship or guaranteed secrets. Refusal, failure and parting still leave room to ask directions, change work and repair another device.

xinghai-life-unfinished-paths.name: Discoveries, Answers and Your Own Road
xinghai-life-unfinished-paths.brief_description: Local lives continue; an answer may end an affair or change a later encounter.
xinghai-life-unfinished-paths.content:
A region supports work, visits, training, trade and travel without requiring an accepted task. A mystery begins with a concrete anomaly and traceable evidence. Following it should answer the original question. An ordinary, sad or partial answer is valid without another mastermind behind it.

Goals grow from circumstances: obtaining tools, learning a method, repairing a weapon, finding lodging or completing a trustworthy delivery. These can intersect without becoming a shared checklist or scheduled grind. A real completion leaves stable consequences; reopening it needs a new cause and contact.

A distant change is not automatically known. A received message, visit or investigation establishes what the player learns. Goodwill or caution belongs to the person expressing it. Refusal, rest and changing direction remain available. A resolved mystery does not reset through amnesia or repeated rewards.

xinghai-c01.name: Outer Ring Pipefitter
xinghai-c01.description: A gritty maintenance worker surviving along station underbellies. Familiar with conduit repair, scrap rigging, and surviving cold pressure leaks.
xinghai-c01.profile: Arriving at Jubilee Hub aboard an unregistered freighter, you carved out an existence fixing high-pressure vents, routing cables, and salvaging junk throughout the exterior maintenance shafts. Living on dry rations and odd gigs has made you tough, cautious, and resilient. Despite mounting arrears on your cubicle, the hub is teeming with salvage ships and hiring syndicates waiting for a capable wrench.
xinghai-c01.origin: Decompression Corridor 47 on Jubilee Hub's outer ring. Exposed conduits hum amid the metallic chill of nearby airlocks.
xinghai-c01.opening_text: The sodium strip-lights flicker intermittently along Corridor 47, casting long shadows across condensation-slicked deckplates. Down the hallway, a small collections drone hovers stubbornly, blinking its crimson sensor across an overdue notice. Station audio drones a calm reminder that routine vacuum purging of this section begins shortly. Toward the bulkhead, the reinforced blast doors of the Old Anchor Bar remain open, while the freight gantry descends toward Shipyard Three. It is time to move.

xinghai-c02.name: Frontline Field Quartermaster
xinghai-c02.description: A trench-hardened auxiliary veteran. Adept at salvaging wrecked power cells, stabilizing trauma gear, and navigating active combat logistics.
xinghai-c02.profile: Stationed along the besieged Sunil planetary line, you served amid scorched trenches and fortified redoubts. Your daily routine involved prying undamaged power units from acid-corroded rigs, adjusting field braces, and recovering fallen service tags. Enduring artillery barrages and harsh rationing has instilled in you steady hands, practical combat triage, and an instinct for opportunity amidst devastation.
xinghai-c02.origin: Logistics Depot inside the Iron Bastion. Rhythmic artillery fire rumbles outside armored bulkheads smelling of antiseptic and coolant.
xinghai-c02.opening_text: Dull concussions rattle the reinforced deckplates as outer defenses engage incoming threats beyond the Iron Bastion. Near the worktable, Medic Lina secures trauma wraps while an overhead amber strobe alerts personnel to verify clear transit corridors. At your side rest a heavy prybar, a tension leg brace, and three recovered soldier dog tags ready for logging. The rear hatch slopes down toward the subterranean shelter city, while the forward airlock connects to the staging ditch. The next step is yours.

xinghai-c03.name: Black Market Guide
xinghai-c03.description: A sharp-eyed courier who knows the crevices of the floating haven. Skilled in assessing illicit salvage and slipping past patrol routes without a sound.
xinghai-c03.profile: Growing up across the wind-sheared cliff markets of Floating Island Dragon Void, you earned your keep running errands for fences, mercenaries, and drifters. You can spot counterfeit power crystals at a glance, know patrol intervals by heart, and can navigate narrow cliff crevices in pitch darkness. This lawless yet thriving hub gives you the connections and streetcraft needed to venture into the broader cosmos.
xinghai-c03.origin: Cliff Market Corridor on Dragon Void. Updraft winds howl from the void below, whistling past rows of makeshift trading stalls.
xinghai-c03.opening_text: Antigravity updrafts whistle up the sheer cliff face, fluttering the tarpaulins of the rockside bazaar. At the wooden boardwalk, a logistics runner tallies accounts while sudden thuds echo from the lower stairs. An injured broker slumps against a mooring bollard, fingers tightly clamped around a glowing memory fragment. Further up the corridor, two cloaked figures round the stone curve, scanning the platform. You could step in to investigate, blend into the shadows of a familiar bypass, or signal the nearest perimeter guard.

xinghai-s01.description: Parts lie in small piles; work begins by finding the missing piece.
xinghai-s01.background: Juberly apprentices soon discover that a master notices both a wrong screw and a tool not returned.

xinghai-s02.description: A wire bypasses a blackened path, finding room in an already crowded circuit.
xinghai-s02.background: Emergency wiring is seldom elegant. Whether the next repairer can understand it matters more than how loudly the emergency was announced.

xinghai-s03.description: An empty frame and a walking body produce different readings; calibration follows the wearer’s balance.
xinghai-s03.background: Buyers ask about speed; repairers ask where it chafes. Some problems only reveal themselves after a long corridor.

xinghai-s04.description: Each winding rests on another; neat-looking ends can hide the smallest misalignment.
xinghai-s04.background: Workshops keep rejected pieces for apprentices: beautiful enough to sell, with the fault buried inside.

xinghai-s05.description: Arrows on a diagram begin to show where energy divides and returns, not merely where it points.
xinghai-s05.background: People may recite definitions yet fail to explain a burnt connector. This knowledge is often reread at an old bench.

xinghai-s06.description: Before boosting, watch the shield edge rather than its prettiest peak reading.
xinghai-s06.background: A technician willing to sign a modification often leaves a way to reverse it. Reputation depends on more than the first bright activation.

xinghai-s07.description: Before the shell closes, small differences in tracking and turning remain to be felt out.
xinghai-s07.background: A following turret can look like an obedient toy. Repair benches keep a worn label nearby: isolate power first.

xinghai-s08.description: Long components line the bench; even an inconspicuous joint cannot be fitted by guesswork.
xinghai-s08.background: Customers enjoy battle stories. Makers remember batches and inspection marks: faults leave the bench bearing a signature too.

xinghai-s09.description: When the reactor’s pitch changes, attention shifts from the peak to hesitation on the way down.
xinghai-s09.background: Old ship engineers dislike “free thrust.” They remember whose hands must enter the hot compartment at the next service.

xinghai-s10.description: Identify the layer answering before deciding whether to ask the next question.
xinghai-s10.background: An ancient interface may pause; a self-aware voice may refuse. Treating both as locks misses the difference.

xinghai-s11.description: Sort usable remnants before working; few tools are no excuse for a disordered bench.
xinghai-s11.background: Field technicians keep failed parts long enough to show why another gamble would be wrong. Haste does not identify materials for you.

xinghai-s12.description: When force meets a machine’s response, attend to the small mismatch before trying to overpower it.
xinghai-s12.background: Apprentices remember the novelty. Older mechanics ask whether they can still distinguish the response after withdrawing their hand.

xinghai-s13.description: The movement is short, the step shorter, recovering without surrendering room to turn.
xinghai-s13.background: Mercenary instruction spreads less through impressive names than a veteran’s first warning: do not stand there.

xinghai-s14.description: Force continues through small circuits; outwardly only the breath seems changed.
xinghai-s14.background: Some dismiss it until a long assignment brings them home ready to ask about the quiet practice they neglected.

xinghai-s15.description: Force joins footing to blade; practice first keeps that connection intact.
xinghai-s15.background: Sunil warblade stories carry weight, yet their opening lesson remains standing properly. The ship-cleaving name cannot skip work on the ground.

xinghai-s16.description: As impact approaches, the frame gathers without trapping the breath behind clenched teeth.
xinghai-s16.background: Old armor dents hide how their owner moved. Veterans include the avoided hit in the lesson too.

xinghai-s17.description: A brief surge compresses movement; the breath afterward deserves equal attention.
xinghai-s17.background: Recruitment demonstrations favor the dazzling moment. Teammates watch whether a withdrawal order can still be followed after it.

xinghai-s18.description: Settle the frightened breath before distinguishing the body’s warnings.
xinghai-s18.background: A space instructor does not call one survival a conquest of vacuum. First comes the airlock, then the account of what happened.

xinghai-s19.description: Thought gathers around a discernible boundary; not every surviving noise needs an answer.
xinghai-s19.background: Beginners struggle not only with fear but with proving themselves fearless. A boast is no support for a barrier.

xinghai-s20.description: Pause over a tiny deviation rather than hurrying to call a coincidence control.
xinghai-s20.background: Strange motion in freefall invites errors. Instruction begins by observing what would happen without intervention.

xinghai-s21.description: Do not supply the missing half of a whisper that almost makes sense.
xinghai-s21.background: Some mistake listening for courage, then cannot recall where the first voice came from. Resistance may begin by declining to hear.

xinghai-s22.description: The crystal’s changes of light have a rhythm of their own; approach with a settled breath.
xinghai-s22.background: Market stalls display the brightest samples. A practitioner learns not to let brightness hurry a hand.

xinghai-s23.description: When the arc brightens, attention stays on gesture and the boundary where it must stop.
xinghai-s23.background: A workshop’s separated practice station is no theatrical stage. Even packing up preserves that unremarkable gap.

xinghai-s24.description: A material’s texture separates into layers; more detail calls for slower judgment.
xinghai-s24.background: The alloy label on an old component can seem younger than its service life. Looking within also means admitting when detail remains unclear.

xinghai-s25.description: Read the identity record as a whole; an inappropriately tidy detail can matter more than complexity.
xinghai-s25.background: Forgers boast about their craft. Experienced checkers linger over the small details nobody wants to explain.

xinghai-s26.description: Choose the stopping point before each burst; silence behind you does not mean absence of cost.
xinghai-s26.background: Experienced space infiltrators praise silence less than they ask whether a return remains possible.

xinghai-s27.description: Before placement, notice who else relies on electronics; remember what you leave behind.
xinghai-s27.background: Reliable mercenaries remember a teammate’s live communicator as well as a target. A plan should not require allies to guess afterward.

xinghai-s28.description: Pressure and latches behave differently; controlled tool use begins by respecting both.
xinghai-s28.background: Wreck technicians leave inspection marks so the next team will not mistake the same dangerous door for an untouched entrance.

xinghai-s29.description: Reorder noise by time and look for recurrence before completing half-heard words.
xinghai-s29.background: A recording behaves differently on different equipment. Keeping the original is not nostalgia; it leaves somewhere to return for a check.

xinghai-s30.description: Leave a beat after a coded phrase; the answer may lie in the half-sentence not returned.
xinghai-s30.background: Old traders seldom pour out every code they know. Speech may open a door; agreement still belongs to the other side.

xinghai-s31.description: Changing language begins with the weight of an address, not moving words one by one.
xinghai-s31.background: One courtesy can cause several misunderstandings in a mercenary hall. A useful interpreter is willing to ask what was meant.

xinghai-s32.description: A handsome curve still needs the mass, speed and position at departure.
xinghai-s32.background: Owners admire fuel-saving arrows. Navigators keep erased routes on working charts to remember why those paths were rejected.

xinghai-s33.description: Inspect seals and wear before hearing which war the crates supposedly survived.
xinghai-s33.background: The same fresh oil hides very different faults. Valuation separates questions about goods from compliments to a seller.

xinghai-s34.description: Compare coordinates again before departure; familiarity is no reason to agree from memory.
xinghai-s34.background: Freighters seek another pair of eyes for a check. Losing face over one typo costs less than carrying it into the unknown.

xinghai-s35.description: The dose, wound and breathing patient must all be considered before application.
xinghai-s35.background: Field medics dislike a miracle described as one quick press. Careful tending often begins after the injection.

xinghai-s36.description: Learn what the other person can decide before placing a request within that authority.
xinghai-s36.background: Across civilizations, courtesy can obscure who actually agreed. Experience includes asking the important sentence one more time.

xinghai-i01.description: Modification points outnumber ornaments, and the shoulder feels its honest weight.
xinghai-i01.background: A used-weapon counter may carry an inspection sheet older than the casing. Ask who checked it last before counting its battle stories.

xinghai-i02.description: Teeth rest within a compact body above a textured, oiled grip.
xinghai-i02.background: Repairers set a stopped chain blade apart from ordinary knives. A quiet machine still deserves a machine’s care.

xinghai-i03.description: Folded tight, it shows use more readily at metal joints than on its shell.
xinghai-i03.background: Sunil warblades are often recalled through their wielders. A model can be priced at a counter; its owner’s stories cannot.

xinghai-i04.description: Six closely spaced barrels meet solid mounting and grip points.
xinghai-i04.background: The shelf name is impressive; delivery time often goes into checking accompanying parts. Carrying the body away does not assemble the rest by wish.

xinghai-i05.description: Layered covers close around the launcher, with service marks left visible.
xinghai-i05.background: An empty display can look formidable. People who handle loading pay more attention to its itemized sheet.

xinghai-i06.description: The compact grip carries a low-set charge indicator, checked before stowing.
xinghai-i06.background: Station personnel may keep one nearby and complain about dust in its port. A gun’s daily annoyances need not be legendary.

xinghai-i08.description: Insulated sections divide the fork’s head; the grip feels more like a heavy tool than expected.
xinghai-i08.background: Crowd-control equipment passes through many hands. Inspectors first seek the last carrier’s impact marks, not the remaining shine.

xinghai-i09.description: Leg joints look older than the chest shell; fitting begins by matching one’s own stride.
xinghai-i09.background: Sunil logistics records replaced parts. The model name may remain, but a wearer must learn each joint anew.

xinghai-i10.description: Nozzles rest behind the wearer while buckles click softly as the straps tighten.
xinghai-i10.background: Repairers ask who will wear it. A graceful demonstration stand cannot account for a real person’s first shift of weight.

xinghai-i11.description: Folding parts hide inside the wristband, its edges worn by daily fastening.
xinghai-i11.background: Buyers ask how bright deployment looks. Technicians open the inner clasp, where a familiar object often develops its first fault.

xinghai-i12.description: The visor frame fits tightly, inspection lines more conspicuous than fabric color.
xinghai-i12.background: Space workers resent being hurried through seal checks, not the checks themselves. The suit begins as a preparation that must be taken seriously.

xinghai-i13.description: Heavy soles make their weight felt again on the first released step.
xinghai-i13.background: New crew complain that walking feels like cargo work. Veterans point toward old ceiling impacts and leave the answer there.

xinghai-i14.description: A close lining surrounds small port covers easily missed during cleaning.
xinghai-i14.background: Its label is handsome; its service record simply states layers replaced and points checked. The plainer writing is often more reassuring.

xinghai-i15.description: A hard, flat ceramic surface sits inside binding that smooths its fit under clothing.
xinghai-i15.background: Removed plates are not casually returned to stock. A tidy surface is not the whole case for continued service.

xinghai-i16.description: The lead weave hangs heavily, the lowered hood taking away a patch of light.
xinghai-i16.background: Old mining-station hooks bend under the weight. Advertisements supply romance; workers first learn to settle the straps.

xinghai-leg-brace.description: Old scratches surround a clean, recently wiped strip at the moving joint.
xinghai-leg-brace.background: A used frame changes owners without forgetting wear. Its new user learns which noises mean looseness and which call for a stop.

xinghai-frigate.description: Hull patches differ in color, and cabin seams recall several refits.
xinghai-frigate.background: Dealers call an old ship experienced; engineers ask how often that experience led into a dock. Dreams still need maintenance.

xinghai-drone.description: A small body makes constant tracking adjustments; at rest its service ports finally become clear.
xinghai-drone.background: Some dockworkers name their drones; others remember only numbers. Both watch the return light when contact is lost.

xinghai-signal-processor.description: The bulky case carries handling-worn labels beside its grips and dust in the vents.
xinghai-signal-processor.background: Repair stalls treat it as vehicle-mounted computing equipment, not a magical ear. Keeping the original recording leaves another round of patient analysis possible.

xinghai-foundation-1.description: A steady defensive foundation, practiced until protection follows the movement rather than arriving after the blow.
xinghai-foundation-1.background: Published training notes carry the method. Copying its steps is only a beginning; proficiency comes from repeated, deliberate practice.

xinghai-advanced-strike-1.description: Concentrates the practiced foundation into a direct strike, with a noticeable cost in energy.
xinghai-advanced-strike-1.background: Published training notes carry the method. Copying its steps is only a beginning; proficiency comes from repeated, deliberate practice.

xinghai-advanced-manual-1.description: Diagrams and correction marks fill the notes. Buying a copy does not replace the time spent studying it.
xinghai-advanced-manual-1.background: An openly sold continuation for readers with the necessary foundation. Some keep it on a shelf until they are ready.

xinghai-advanced-weapon-1.description: Fine lines meet along the edge, while the grip stays deliberately plain. Its balance rewards a practiced hand.
xinghai-advanced-weapon-1.background: Inspection marks remain beside the fittings. A later owner can tune it further, but must work with the actual piece.

xinghai-advanced-armor-1.description: Offset layers sit close during movement and distribute the force of a direct hit.
xinghai-advanced-armor-1.background: The garment cannot read an opponent for its wearer. Careful users watch its wear and know when to step back.

xinghai-force-a.description: Dust hangs still as a tightening field folds forward with the hand.
xinghai-force-a.background: Field adepts learn to contain the spill before concentrating pressure, keeping companions behind them outside its reach.

xinghai-martial-a.description: A firmly planted stance gives way to a short strike and a snap of cloth.
xinghai-martial-a.background: Martial veterans drill close-range force behind a guarded center; fatigue and injury still matter.

xinghai-psychic-a.description: Layered thought-waves arrive on unequal beats as the gaze steadies.
xinghai-psychic-a.background: Psychic adepts alternate short pulses, leaving room to recover while testing an opponent’s concentration.

xinghai-spell-a.description: An arc of refracted light folds into a narrow loop around the sleeve.
xinghai-spell-a.background: Researchers join cover and retaliation in neighboring beats, sustaining the pattern through their own effort.

xinghai-energy-a.description: Loose radiance narrows at the fingertips, leaving a brief heated line.
xinghai-energy-a.background: Energy wielders practice concentration rather than spectacle, directing a measured reserve toward a chosen point.

xinghai-mechanic-a.description: Several guide circuits flicker in turn as a close-range fire net tightens.
xinghai-mechanic-a.background: Veteran mechanics interleave carried circuits for fire and cover, paying the energy cost of each cycle.

xinghai-death-c.description: A dim mote leaves the palm like a breath cut short.
xinghai-death-c.background: Early use of withering energy depends on restraint; legendary resurrection remains far beyond this close-range practice.

xinghai-carbon-a.description: Fine black crystals spread beside the body and gather into an edged screen.
xinghai-carbon-a.background: Matter wielders combine cover with short-range cutting, constantly adjusting the pattern rather than relying on spectacle.

xinghai-linked-emitter.description: The emitter folds against the forearm, revealing close-set cooling slots when opened.
xinghai-linked-emitter.background: Mobile mechanics keep a carried emitter beside their heavier installations. Even careful workmanship needs cells and maintenance.

xinghai-field-robe.description: Soft cloth reveals layered fibers only under slanting light.
xinghai-field-robe.background: Adepts working around high energies favor light protective clothing, then patiently mend its worn outer layers.

xinghai-mechanic-c.description: The wrist conduits light in sequence, gathering a brief directed volley.
xinghai-mechanic-c.background: Mechanics rehearse close-range fire and cover together, relying on carried equipment and practiced judgment.

xinghai-space-breach.description: A close field concentrates blows against hull seams and sustains the fighter in vacuum. Light raiders can be broken; armored interceptors and concentrated fire remain lethal.
xinghai-space-breach.background: A specialized chapter requires the corresponding foundation and sustained practice of breathing, force and orientation. Reading its title alone does not permit vacuum combat.

xinghai-space-slip.description: Repeated short slips through nearby folds sustain vacuum protection and evade crude fire control. It favors escape over hull damage; specialized interdiction can still bar the way.
xinghai-space-slip.background: A specialized chapter requires the corresponding foundation and sustained practice of breathing, force and orientation. Reading its title alone does not permit vacuum combat.

xinghai-space-dominion.description: A sustained envelope lets the fighter withstand ship weapons and strike through heavy hulls. Mastery can overcome small formations, at substantial ongoing energy cost; strategic firepower and layered interdiction remain serious threats.
xinghai-space-dominion.background: A specialized chapter requires the corresponding foundation and sustained practice of breathing, force and orientation. Reading its title alone does not permit vacuum combat.
